Yn y fersiwn ddwyieithog, mae’r golofn chwith yn cynnwys yr iaith a lefarwyd yn y cyfarfod. Mae’r golofn dde yn cynnwys cyfieithiad o’r areithiau hynny.

Mae [R] yn dynodi bod yr Aelod wedi datgan buddiant wrth gyflwyno’r busnes.

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim: Prynhawn da. Croeso i sesiwn ddydd Mercher. Cwestiynau i'r Gweinidog Cabinet dros Fenter, Cysylltedd ac Ynni. Cwestiwn 1, Vikki Howells.
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated: Good afternoon and welcome to Wednesday's Plenary session. Questions to the Cabinet Minister for Enterprise, Connectivity and Energy. Question 1, Vikki Howells.

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated: Public Transport

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_welsh: 1. Cwestiynau i’r Gweinidog Cabinet dros Fenter, Cysylltedd ac Ynni
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 1. Questions to the Cabinet Minister for Enterprise, Connectivity and Energy
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim: 1. Beth yw blaenoriaethau Llywodraeth Cymru ar gyfer gwella mynediad at drafnidiaeth gyhoeddus ym Mhontypridd Cynon Merthyr? OQ64484
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated: 1. What are the Welsh Government's priorities for improving access to public transport in Pontypridd Cynon Merthyr? OQ64484

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_welsh: 1. Cwestiynau i’r Gweinidog Cabinet dros Fenter, Cysylltedd ac Ynni
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 1. Questions to the Cabinet Minister for Enterprise, Connectivity and Energy
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim: Diolch am y cwestiwn, Vikki. Rydyn ni eisiau ei gwneud hi’n haws i fwy o bobl deithio ar fws ac ar drên ym Mhontypridd Cynon Merthyr. Mae hyn yn golygu bysiau a threnau sy’n gweithio’n well gyda’i gilydd, prisiau teg, a gwasanaethau sy’n dod ar amser. Mae metro de Cymru yn rhan bwysig o’r gwaith hwn. Rydyn ni hefyd yn rhoi arian i wella bysiau lleol a llefydd fel gorsaf Merthyr.
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated: Thank you for the question, Vikki. We want to make it easier for more people to travel on buses and trains in Pontypridd Cynon Merthyr. That means better connections between bus and rail, keeping fares fair and providing reliable services. The south Wales metro is central to this work. We are also investing in improving local bus services and improving interchanges such as Merthyr.

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_welsh: 1. Cwestiynau i’r Gweinidog Cabinet dros Fenter, Cysylltedd ac Ynni
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 1. Questions to the Cabinet Minister for Enterprise, Connectivity and Energy
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim: Thank you, Deputy Minister. Now, capping bus fares at £2 for adults was a key pledge in my party's manifesto from May, building on our work in Government, where we introduced £1 bus fares for young people and provided free bus travel for older people and people with disabilities. Now, Prime Minister Andy Burnham has announced that, from January 2027, single bus fares in England will be capped at £2 for adults. This will, of course, mean a Barnett consequential for the Welsh Government. So, will you use this to introduce a similar £2 cap for fares in Wales? And if not, will you explain why bus users in Wales should lose out?
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated: Diolch, Ddirprwy Weinidog. Nawr, roedd rhoi cap o £2 ar brisiau tocynnau bysiau i oedolion yn addewid allweddol ym maniffesto fy mhlaid o fis Mai, gan adeiladu ar ein gwaith yn y Llywodraeth, lle gwnaethom gyflwyno tocynnau bysiau £1 i bobl ifanc a darparu teithiau bws am ddim i bobl hŷn a phobl ag anableddau. Nawr, mae Prif Weinidog y DU Andy Burnham wedi cyhoeddi y bydd prisiau tocynnau bysiau sengl yn Lloegr i oedolion yn cael eu capio ar £2 o fis Ionawr 2027 ymlaen. Bydd hyn, wrth gwrs, yn golygu cyllid canlyniadol Barnett i Lywodraeth Cymru. Felly, a wnewch chi ddefnyddio hwn i gyflwyno cap tebyg o £2 ar brisiau tocynnau yng Nghymru? Ac os na, a wnewch chi egluro pam y dylai defnyddwyr bysiau yng Nghymru fod ar eu colled?

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_welsh: 1. Cwestiynau i’r Gweinidog Cabinet dros Fenter, Cysylltedd ac Ynni
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 1. Questions to the Cabinet Minister for Enterprise, Connectivity and Energy
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim: This Government is committed to buses being a key part of the transport infrastructure, especially for those people who maybe cannot afford and don't have access to a private car. We've made sure that the bus fare for young people is continued and that's a commitment throughout the term of this Government. It was in the programme for government that we talked about yesterday. We're looking forward to seeing the consequentials come in, but, as an ex-Minister, you know that the consequentials come into the Government, the Government then decides on the priorities it sets to that. You've seen the priorities in the programme for government yesterday. But if I can give you one reassurance, I think that bus services are one of the key things that this Government will be differentiating itself for over the next four years, because we recognise the importance of them to those people who are furthest away from their own transport solutions.
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated: Mae'r Llywodraeth hon wedi ymrwymo i fysiau fod yn rhan allweddol o'r seilwaith trafnidiaeth, yn enwedig i'r bobl hynny na allant fforddio ac nad oes ganddynt gar preifat at eu defnydd. Rydym wedi sicrhau bod y tocyn bws i bobl ifanc yn parhau, ac mae hwnnw'n ymrwymiad drwy gydol tymor y Llywodraeth hon. Roedd yn y rhaglen lywodraethu y buom yn siarad amdani ddoe. Edrychwn ymlaen at weld y cyllid canlyniadol, ond fel cyn-Weinidog, fe wyddoch fod y cyllid canlyniadol yn dod i'r Llywodraeth, ac mae'r Llywodraeth yn penderfynu wedyn ar y blaenoriaethau y mae'n eu pennu ar ei gyfer. Rydych chi wedi gweld y blaenoriaethau ddoe yn y rhaglen lywodraethu. Ond os caf roi un sicrwydd i chi, credaf y bydd gwasanaethau bysiau yn un o'r pethau allweddol a fydd yn diffinio'r Llywodraeth hon dros y pedair blynedd nesaf, gan ein bod yn cydnabod eu pwysigrwydd i'r bobl sydd bellaf i ffwrdd o'u hatebion trafnidiaeth eu hunain.

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_welsh: 1. Cwestiynau i’r Gweinidog Cabinet dros Fenter, Cysylltedd ac Ynni
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 1. Questions to the Cabinet Minister for Enterprise, Connectivity and Energy
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim: Minister, many people in Pontypridd Cynon Merthyr still struggle to access jobs, education and healthcare because of poor transport links. Given the significant amount of public money already spent on transport projects in Wales, can the Cabinet Secretary please explain why so many communities remain poorly served, and what steps will be taken to improve reliability and accessibility before asking taxpayers to fund further major schemes? Thank you.
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated: Weinidog, mae llawer o bobl ym Mhontypridd Cynon Merthyr yn dal i'w chael hi'n anodd cael mynediad at swyddi, addysg a gofal iechyd oherwydd cysylltiadau trafnidiaeth gwael. O ystyried y swm sylweddol o arian cyhoeddus sydd eisoes wedi'i wario ar brosiectau trafnidiaeth yng Nghymru, a all Ysgrifennydd y Cabinet egluro pam y mae cymaint o gymunedau'n dal i gael eu gwasanaethu'n wael, a pha gamau a gaiff eu cymryd i wella dibynadwyedd a hygyrchedd cyn gofyn i drethdalwyr ariannu cynlluniau mawr pellach? Diolch.

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_welsh: 1. Cwestiynau i’r Gweinidog Cabinet dros Fenter, Cysylltedd ac Ynni
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 1. Questions to the Cabinet Minister for Enterprise, Connectivity and Energy
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim: Thank you for the question, David. I think the key thing for this is actually starting to recognise the truth of the matter. We've got a Transport for Wales service that's hitting its time targets ahead of everyone else in the UK. The latest statistics show that Transport for Wales was hitting over 80 per cent within three minutes of its required time. So, it is providing the service it needs to provide. The second part of this is about making sure we have the funding to be able to invest in that infrastructure. If I remember, when we talked about rail devolution when I came to this Siambr relatively recently, the benches behind me were against us having extra rail devolution, which is for precisely the same reasons that you're asking the questions. We want to make sure that people can access jobs, healthcare and just make society work. I'm just going to reiterate a point I made to Vikki a few seconds ago. This is important for us in terms of not just rail transport, it's important to us from a bus perspective as well, and I think that's going to be key for these four years ahead.
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated: Diolch am y cwestiwn, David. Credaf mai'r peth allweddol ar gyfer hyn yw dechrau cydnabod gwirionedd y mater. Mae gennym wasanaeth Trafnidiaeth Cymru sy'n cyflawni ei dargedau amser o flaen pawb arall yn y DU. Mae'r ystadegau diweddaraf yn dangos bod Trafnidiaeth Cymru yn cyflawni dros 80 y cant o fewn tair munud o'i amser gofynnol. Felly, mae'n darparu'r gwasanaeth y mae angen iddo ei ddarparu. Yr ail ran o hyn yw sicrhau bod gennym gyllid i allu buddsoddi yn y seilwaith hwnnw. Os cofiaf, pan oeddem yn trafod datganoli rheilffyrdd pan ddeuthum i'r Siambr hon yn gymharol ddiweddar, roedd y meinciau y tu ôl i mi yn erbyn datganoli pellach mewn perthynas â rheilffyrdd, am yr un rhesymau'n union ag yr ydych chi'n gofyn y cwestiynau. Rydym am sicrhau y gall pobl gael mynediad at swyddi, gofal iechyd a gwneud i gymdeithas weithio. Rwy’n mynd i ailadrodd pwynt a wneuthum i Vikki ychydig eiliadau yn ôl. Mae hyn yn bwysig i ni nid yn unig o ran trafnidiaeth rheilffyrdd, mae'n bwysig i ni o ran bysiau hefyd, a chredaf y bydd hynny'n allweddol ar gyfer y pedair blynedd nesaf.

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_welsh: 1. Cwestiynau i’r Gweinidog Cabinet dros Fenter, Cysylltedd ac Ynni
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 1. Questions to the Cabinet Minister for Enterprise, Connectivity and Energy
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim: Mae rhieni a phlant ar draws Rhondda Cynon Taf yn pryderu am effeithiau penderfyniad y cyngor, sydd o dan arweiniad Llafur, i wneud cludiant ysgol mor gymhleth â phosib i blant sydd jest eisiau gofyn, 'A ydw i'n mynd i gyrraedd yr ysgol yn ddiogel?' Mae canlyniadau'r penderfyniad yma yn sylweddol. Mae'n effeithio ar bobl leol sydd ddim yn gallu mynd ar y bws oherwydd ei fod yn llawn disgyblion ar y ffordd i'r ysgol ac mae presenoldeb disgyblion yn yr ysgol wedi'i effeithio'n ddifrifol. Yn fwy pryderus byth, mae plant yn methu mynd i'r ysgol maen nhw eisiau, gan gynnwys ysgolion cyfrwng Cymraeg, oherwydd bod llai o fysiau ar gael neu oherwydd newidiadau i delerau'r Mesur Teithio gan Ddysgwyr (Cymru) 2008. Dirprwy Weinidog, a wnewch chi wneud datganiad heddiw yn cefnogi rhieni Rhondda Cynon Taf sydd am wneud i'r cyngor, sydd o dan arweiniad Llafur, flaenoriaethu diogelwch plant?
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated: Parents and children across Rhondda Cynon Taf are concerned about the impact of the council's decisions, which is a Labour-led council, to make school transport as complex as possible for children who just want to know whether they're going to get to school safely. The impact of this decision is significant. It affects local people who can't get on the bus because it is full of school pupils on their way to school and pupil attendance has been gravely affected. More concerning still, children can't go to the school they want to go to, including Welsh-medium schools, because there are fewer buses available or because of changes to the terms of the Learner Travel (Wales) Measure 2008. Deputy Minister, will you make a statement today supporting parents in RCT who want to make the Labour-led council prioritise the safety of children?

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 1. Questions to the Cabinet Minister for Enterprise, Connectivity and Energy
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim: Diolch am y cwestiwn, Lis.
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated: Thank you for the question, Lis.

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_welsh: 1. Cwestiynau i’r Gweinidog Cabinet dros Fenter, Cysylltedd ac Ynni
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 1. Questions to the Cabinet Minister for Enterprise, Connectivity and Energy
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim: I think there are a couple of things here. One, it's very complicated. I think one of the things that learner travel has shown me is that this is probably the biggest difficult problem I've got on my horizon, excepting that I've got the M4 and the Menai on that as well. So, it shows the complexity of it. And I think it's been shown by this Government that we've taken this on as a cross-portfolio opportunity, because, as you say, this affects—. We're talking about education and Welsh learner education, but also post-16 education. And one of the things that I found most disconcerting is that, ultimately, learner travel and learner transport should be an enabler of people's education; it should not be a disenabler. So, this Government is keen and it was in our 100-day commitment. We've started work on it, particularly in relation to the Welsh language first, but then we're going to be focusing on post-16 education and, following that, it'll be additional learning needs learner transport as well.
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated: Rwy'n credu bod cwpl o bethau yma. Yn gyntaf, mae'n gymhleth iawn. Rwy'n credu mai un o'r pethau y mae teithio gan ddysgwyr wedi'i ddangos i mi yw mai dyma'r broblem anoddaf sydd gennyf ar fy ngorwel, er bod yr M4 a'r Fenai ar y gorwel gennyf hefyd. Felly, mae hynny'n dangos ei gymhlethdod. A chredaf fod y Llywodraeth hon wedi dangos ein bod wedi bwrw ymlaen â hyn fel cyfle trawsbortffolio, oherwydd, fel y dywedwch, mae'n effeithio ar—. Rydym yn siarad am addysg ac addysg dysgwyr Cymraeg, ond hefyd addysg ôl-16. Ac un o'r pethau a oedd yn peri'r pryder mwyaf i mi yw y dylai teithio gan ddysgwyr a chludiant dysgwyr, yn y pen draw, fod yn alluogwyr addysg pobl; ni ddylent fod yn analluogwr. Felly, mae'r Llywodraeth hon yn awyddus, ac roedd yn rhan o'n hymrwymiad 100 diwrnod. Rydym wedi dechrau gweithio arno, yn enwedig mewn perthynas â'r iaith Gymraeg yn gyntaf, ond wedyn byddwn yn canolbwyntio ar addysg ôl-16, ac yn dilyn hynny, byddwn yn canolbwyntio ar gludiant dysgwyr ag anghenion dysgu ychwanegol hefyd.

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated: Energy Policy and Net Zero

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_welsh: 1. Cwestiynau i’r Gweinidog Cabinet dros Fenter, Cysylltedd ac Ynni
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 1. Questions to the Cabinet Minister for Enterprise, Connectivity and Energy
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim: 2. Sut y bydd polisi ynni Llywodraeth Cymru yn cefnogi ei hymdrechion i gyflawni ei thargedau sero net? OQ64525
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated: 2. How will the Welsh Government's energy policy support its efforts to achieve its net-zero targets? OQ64525

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_welsh: 1. Cwestiynau i’r Gweinidog Cabinet dros Fenter, Cysylltedd ac Ynni
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 1. Questions to the Cabinet Minister for Enterprise, Connectivity and Energy
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Member_job_title_English: Cabinet Minister for Enterprise, Connectivity and Energy
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Member_job_title_Welsh: Y Gweinidog Cabinet dros Fenter, Cysylltedd ac Ynni
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim: The Welsh Government’s national energy strategy will take a whole-systems approach, replacing the previous renewable electricity generation target with an emissions-based energy target. This will help identify where action delivers the greatest contribution to our ambition of achieving net zero by 2040.
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated: Bydd strategaeth ynni genedlaethol Llywodraeth Cymru yn mabwysiadu dull system gyfan, gan gyflwyno targed ynni sy'n seiliedig ar allyriadau yn lle'r targed blaenorol ar gyfer cynhyrchu trydan adnewyddadwy. Bydd hyn yn helpu i nodi lle mae gweithredu'n cyflawni'r cyfraniad mwyaf at ein huchelgais o gyflawni sero net erbyn 2040.

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_welsh: 1. Cwestiynau i’r Gweinidog Cabinet dros Fenter, Cysylltedd ac Ynni
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 1. Questions to the Cabinet Minister for Enterprise, Connectivity and Energy
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim: Thank you, Minister. Minister, releasing carbon dioxide into the atmosphere causes temperatures on earth to rise, and that isn't good for any of us. And we need to achieve whatever reduction in emissions is necessary to secure the long-term future of mankind. That's why, in its current formulation, net zero is so frustrating. Deindustrialisation and a reliance on China and India are not long-term solutions. Renewables, again, are not a long-term solution, neither is burying our heads in the sand about the economic and geopolitical problems created by net zero. The only long-term solution to the challenges that we face, both as a nation and as a species, is nuclear power. So, I'm excited about the development of small modular reactors at Wylfa. After that, Minister, what's next for nuclear power in Wales?
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated: Diolch, Weinidog. Weinidog, mae rhyddhau carbon deuocsid i'r atmosffer yn achosi i dymheredd y ddaear godi, ac nid yw hynny'n dda i neb ohonom. Ac mae angen inni gyflawni unrhyw ostyngiad mewn allyriadau sy'n angenrheidiol i sicrhau dyfodol hirdymor dynoliaeth. Dyna pam, ar ei ffurf bresennol, fod sero net yn peri cymaint o rwystredigaeth. Nid yw dad-ddiwydiannu a dibyniaeth ar Tsieina ac India yn atebion hirdymor. Nid yw ynni adnewyddadwy yn ateb hirdymor chwaith, na chuddio ein pennau yn y tywod mewn perthynas â'r problemau economaidd a geowleidyddol a grëir gan sero net. Yr unig ateb hirdymor i'r heriau a wynebwn fel cenedl ac fel rhywogaeth yw ynni niwclear. Felly, rwy'n llawn cyffro ynghylch datblygu adweithyddion modiwlar bach yn Wylfa. Ar ôl hynny, Weinidog, beth sydd nesaf ar gyfer ynni niwclear yng Nghymru?

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_welsh: 1. Cwestiynau i’r Gweinidog Cabinet dros Fenter, Cysylltedd ac Ynni
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 1. Questions to the Cabinet Minister for Enterprise, Connectivity and Energy
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim:
I just would point out to the Member that I think the context is key here, isn't it?  So, the situation in Wales where we have unique assets—latent potential in many cases in terms of green energy—is that, actually, green energy is the means for our reindustrialisation, not our deindustrialisation. I'm specifically referring to, for example, our globally significant potential in terms of floating offshore wind, and the well-known, unique natural advantages we have in terms of tidal technologies, for example. We could, therefore, not just generate the electricity through those technologies, but also capture the supply chain and build up a manufacturing base on that level.

In relation to his point about nuclear, I would just point out that, actually, the move towards an emissions-based target includes not just renewable sectors, but also other low-carbon technologies that include nuclear, alongside carbon capture and storage.
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated:
Hoffwn nodi i'r Aelod fy mod yn credu bod y cyd-destun yn allweddol yma, onid yw? Felly, y sefyllfa yng Nghymru lle mae gennym asedau unigryw—potensial cudd mewn llawer o achosion o ran ynni gwyrdd—yw mai ynni gwyrdd, mewn gwirionedd, yw'r ffordd i'n hailddiwydiannu, nid ein dad-ddiwydiannu. Rwy'n cyfeirio'n benodol, er enghraifft, at ein potensial byd-eang arwyddocaol o ran ffermydd gwynt arnofiol ar y môr, a'r manteision naturiol unigryw tra hysbys sydd gennym o ran technolegau llanw, er enghraifft. Felly, nid yn unig y gallem gynhyrchu'r trydan drwy'r technolegau hynny, ond gallem hefyd fanteisio ar y gadwyn gyflenwi ac adeiladu sylfaen weithgynhyrchu ar y lefel honno.

Ar ei bwynt ynglŷn ag ynni niwclear, hoffwn nodi bod y symudiad tuag at darged sy'n seiliedig ar allyriadau yn cynnwys nid yn unig sectorau adnewyddadwy ond technolegau carbon isel eraill hefyd, gan gynnwys ynni niwclear, ochr yn ochr â dal a storio carbon.

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_welsh: 1. Cwestiynau i’r Gweinidog Cabinet dros Fenter, Cysylltedd ac Ynni
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 1. Questions to the Cabinet Minister for Enterprise, Connectivity and Energy
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim: Dwi'n falch o glywed cyfeiriad y Gweinidog at ailddiwydiannu. Dwi'n croesawu hynny. Byddwn hefyd yn eilio pwysigrwydd y diwydiant niwclear i gwblhau hynny. Yr wythnos diwethaf, bues i lawr yn Hinkley Point, pwerdy niwclear sydd wedi ei adeiladu gyda pheth helaeth o ddur Cymreig, ac mae yna gyfle i fynd ymhellach, y tu hwnt i'r prosiect newydd yn Wylfa, o ran ehangu'r diwydiant niwclear yng Nghymru.
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated: I'm pleased to hear the Minister's reference to reindustrialisation. I welcome that. I would also agree on the importance of the nuclear industry in achieving that. Last week, I visited Hinkley Point, which is a nuclear power station that is being built with a great deal of Welsh steel, and there's an opportunity to go further, beyond the new project in Wylfa, in expanding nuclear in Wales.

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_welsh: 1. Cwestiynau i’r Gweinidog Cabinet dros Fenter, Cysylltedd ac Ynni
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 1. Questions to the Cabinet Minister for Enterprise, Connectivity and Energy
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim: But on the net-zero target set by Welsh Government for 2040, we welcome that target. We will push you on it. But that target is meaningless unless the Minister is prepared to deliver the renewable energy infrastructure needed to achieve it, and you referenced renewables in your earlier answer. Do you accept that Wales cannot reach net zero in that time frame without a major expansion of onshore wind as well as offshore wind, and that that in itself cannot be delivered without grid infrastructure and pylons to connect it? And if you do accept that premise, will you commit to supporting that infrastructure and those projects, even where those decisions prove difficult and locally unpopular?
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated: Ond ar y targed sero net a osodwyd gan Lywodraeth Cymru ar gyfer 2040, rydym yn croesawu'r targed hwnnw. Byddwn yn eich gwthio arno. Ond mae'r targed hwnnw'n ddiystyr oni bai fod y Gweinidog yn barod i ddarparu'r seilwaith ynni adnewyddadwy sydd ei angen i'w gyflawni, ac fe gyfeirioch chi at ynni adnewyddadwy yn eich ateb cynharach. A ydych chi'n derbyn na all Cymru gyflawni sero net yn yr amserlen honno heb ehangu mawr o ran ynni gwynt ar y tir yn ogystal ag ynni gwynt ar y môr, ac na ellir cyflawni hynny ynddo'i hun heb seilwaith grid a pheilonau i'w gysylltu? Ac os ydych chi'n derbyn y rhagdybiaeth honno, a wnewch chi ymrwymo i gefnogi'r seilwaith hwnnw a'r prosiectau hynny, hyd yn oed lle mae'r penderfyniadau hynny'n anodd ac yn amhoblogaidd yn lleol?

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_welsh: 1. Cwestiynau i’r Gweinidog Cabinet dros Fenter, Cysylltedd ac Ynni
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 1. Questions to the Cabinet Minister for Enterprise, Connectivity and Energy
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim:
Rwy'n ddiolchgar i'r Aelod am ei gwestiwn. Mae yna nifer o elfennau yn fanna, ond, wrth gwrs, mae popeth yn gysylltiedig ar ddiwedd y dydd, onid ydy? 

Gyda'r strategaeth ynni genedlaethol, wrth gwrs, un o'r elfennau mawr fydd gosod mas y gwahanol gyfraniadau fydd yn cael eu gwneud fesul technoleg, a wedyn, wrth gwrs, ar lefel gofodol—so, bydd hwnna’n elfen—a gosod mas beth mae’r gwahanol elfennau yn cyfrannu. Mae’r penderfyniad gyda Gwyndod, i bob pwrpas, wedi’i wneud, a dyna’r sail y mae’r holl randdeiliaid ynni ar draws Prydain nawr yn cynllunio arni.

Felly, mae’r elfen yna, wrth gwrs, yn gorfod bod yn rhan ohono fe, ond, yn sicr, rŷn ni’n derbyn bod cyfraniad gydag ynni gwyrdd ar y tir, ac mae yna oblygiadau wedyn o ran sicrhau bod y seilwaith o ran cysylltiadau grid yno i helpu hynny i ddigwydd yn y ffordd fwyaf effeithlon o ran ein systemau ni, a hefyd o ran ein economi, gan, wrth gwrs, gydnabod bod yna angen gydag unrhyw fframwaith cynllunio i gael y balans yn iawn o ran y llais a'r buddiannau cymunedol hefyd.
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated:
I'm grateful to the Member for his question. There are a number of elements to that question, but, of course, everything is connected at the end of the day, isn't it?

With the national energy strategy, one of the major elements will be setting out the different contributions that will be made by each form of technology, and then, of course, at a spatial level—so, that's one aspect—and setting out what the different elements will contribute. The decision with regard to Gwyndod, to all intents and purposes, has already been made, and that's the basis on which all of the energy stakeholders across Britain are planning.

That element has to be a part of the mix, but, certainly, we do accept that there is a contribution to be made by onshore green energy, and there are implications in terms of ensuring that the infrastructure with regard to grid connection is there to facilitate that to happen in the most efficient way with regard to our systems and our economy, recognising, of course, that there is a need in any planning framework to strike the right balance in terms of the interests and voice of the community.

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_welsh: 1. Cwestiynau i’r Gweinidog Cabinet dros Fenter, Cysylltedd ac Ynni
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 1. Questions to the Cabinet Minister for Enterprise, Connectivity and Energy

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_welsh: 1. Cwestiynau i’r Gweinidog Cabinet dros Fenter, Cysylltedd ac Ynni
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 1. Questions to the Cabinet Minister for Enterprise, Connectivity and Energy
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim: Prynhawn da, Weinidog.
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated: Good afternoon, Minister.

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_welsh: 1. Cwestiynau i’r Gweinidog Cabinet dros Fenter, Cysylltedd ac Ynni
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 1. Questions to the Cabinet Minister for Enterprise, Connectivity and Energy
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim:
I'm really pleased to hear from Reform UK that there's not a rejection of the net-zero targets, which we have previously heard. So, I'm hoping that there's been a bit of a change on those benches over there. But I would like just to come back on the point that was made by Joe Martin in relation to selective forms of energy, because what we should be doing is everything. The world is on fire. We've seen the wildfires across Wales this summer, and, actually, we have at our fingertips the opportunity to deliver a whole raft of renewable energy, and here in Wales, as you've said, we've got a real opportunity.

Very different to my friend on my right—you're not on the right, I know—. We've talked about this before, but I would like to give you another opportunity, just to be clear on this, that, in developing onshore wind, your commitment still is to undergrounding those transmission cables, because that's what our communities want. I'm hoping you'll confirm that, and also that we're looking at how communities can own that onshore wind as well. Diolch yn fawr iawn.
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated:
Rwy'n falch iawn o glywed gan Reform UK nad ydynt yn gwrthod y targedau sero net, fel rydym wedi'i glywed o'r blaen. Felly, rwy'n gobeithio bod newid bach wedi bod ar y meinciau hynny. Ond hoffwn ddod yn ôl at y pwynt a wnaed gan Joe Martin mewn perthynas â mathau dethol o ynni, gan mai'r hyn y dylem fod yn ei wneud yw popeth. Mae'r byd ar dân. Rydym wedi gweld y tanau gwyllt ledled Cymru yr haf hwn, ac mewn gwirionedd, mae gennym gyfle yma i ddarparu llu o fathau o ynni adnewyddadwy, ac yma yng Nghymru, fel y dywedoch chi, mae gennym gyfle go iawn.

Yn wahanol iawn i fy nghyfaill ar fy llaw dde—nid ydych ar y dde, rwy'n gwybod hynny—. Rydym wedi siarad am hyn o'r blaen, ond hoffwn roi cyfle arall i chi, dim ond i fod yn glir ar hyn, mai eich ymrwymiad o hyd wrth ddatblygu ynni gwynt ar y tir yw tanddaearu'r ceblau trawsyrru hynny, gan mai dyna mae ein cymunedau ei eisiau. Rwy'n gobeithio y gwnewch chi gadarnhau hynny, a hefyd ein bod yn edrych ar sut y gall cymunedau fod yn berchen ar yr ynni gwynt ar y tir hwnnw hefyd. Diolch yn fawr iawn.

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_welsh: 1. Cwestiynau i’r Gweinidog Cabinet dros Fenter, Cysylltedd ac Ynni
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 1. Questions to the Cabinet Minister for Enterprise, Connectivity and Energy
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim:
I'm grateful to the Member for her question, and she is absolutely right, of course, that our national energy strategy will be looking particularly at those technologies where Wales is well placed, in terms of its natural assets, in the way that I described, to develop. But we need to be mindful, of course, of nascent technologies, which are at different stages of maturity at any point. So, this area never stands still, and we need to be building the capacity for Wales to be a test bed for some of those technologies that are on the horizon as well. 

In relation to grid infrastructure, can I take the opportunity as well to say—I should be able to recite this without looking at my notes—that we are clearly committed to delivering our manifesto commitment in relation to the distribution network of 132 kV and below, which is in favour of undergrounding, with only exceptions in terms of overhead, through low wooden poles, or other similar, equally unintrusive infrastructure?
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated:
Rwy'n ddiolchgar i'r Aelod am ei chwestiwn, ac mae hi'n llygad ei lle, wrth gwrs, y bydd ein strategaeth ynni genedlaethol yn edrych yn benodol ar y technolegau hynny lle mae Cymru mewn sefyllfa dda, o ran ei hasedau naturiol, yn y ffordd a ddisgrifiais, i ddatblygu. Ond mae angen inni fod yn ymwybodol, wrth gwrs, o dechnolegau newydd, sydd ar wahanol gamau o aeddfedrwydd ar unrhyw adeg. Felly, nid yw'r maes hwn byth yn sefyll yn llonydd, ac mae angen inni feithrin y gallu i Gymru fod yn faes profi ar gyfer rhai o'r technolegau sydd ar y gorwel hefyd.

Ar seilwaith grid, a gaf i fanteisio ar y cyfle hefyd i ddweud—dylwn allu dweud hyn heb edrych ar fy nodiadau—ein bod wedi ymrwymo’n glir i gyflawni ein hymrwymiad maniffesto mewn perthynas â’r rhwydwaith dosbarthu 132 kV neu lai, sydd o blaid tanddaearu, gydag eithriadau'n unig o ran llinellau uwchben, drwy bolion pren isel, neu seilwaith tebyg arall sydd yr un mor anymwthiol?

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_welsh: 1. Cwestiynau i’r Gweinidog Cabinet dros Fenter, Cysylltedd ac Ynni
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 1. Questions to the Cabinet Minister for Enterprise, Connectivity and Energy
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim: Cwestiynau Heb Rybudd gan Lefarwyr y Pleidiau
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated: Questions Without Notice from Party Spokespeople

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_welsh: 1. Cwestiynau i’r Gweinidog Cabinet dros Fenter, Cysylltedd ac Ynni
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 1. Questions to the Cabinet Minister for Enterprise, Connectivity and Energy
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim: Diolch. Galwaf yn awr ar lefarwyr y pleidiau i holi. Llefarydd Reform UK, Jason O'Connell.
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated: Thank you. I now call the party spokespeople to question the Cabinet Minister. The Reform UK spokesperson, Jason O'Connell.

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_welsh: 1. Cwestiynau i’r Gweinidog Cabinet dros Fenter, Cysylltedd ac Ynni
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 1. Questions to the Cabinet Minister for Enterprise, Connectivity and Energy
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim: Diolch, Ddirprwy Lywydd. Minister, this week marks three years since the introduction of the default 20 mph limit across Wales. That's three years that motorists have been treated as a problem, and three years since this institution has ignored all the calls to overturn this disastrous policy. The cost is 1 billion extra minutes to car journey times across Wales each year. That's 1 billion minutes, and a policy estimated to cost up to £9 billion to the Welsh economy. And, after all of that, Welsh road deaths are still rising throughout the varying speed zones. Now, Minister, every one of those deaths is a tragedy. Road safety deserves a strategy that's more than just changing road signs. For years, when Labour was in Government, your party backed this single-minded approach. You defended it, you backed it, and now the data tells us it's clearly not working. So, Cabinet Minister, will you finally listen to the data and the hundreds of thousands of people who continue to speak out against this policy and end this experiment?
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated: Diolch, Ddirprwy Lywydd. Weinidog, yr wythnos hon mae'n dair blynedd ers cyflwyno’r terfyn diofyn o 20 mya ledled Cymru. Dyna dair blynedd y mae modurwyr wedi cael eu trin fel problem, a thair blynedd ers i’r sefydliad hwn anwybyddu’r holl alwadau i wrthdroi’r polisi trychinebus hwn. Y gost yw 1 biliwn o funudau ychwanegol i amseroedd teithio mewn ceir ledled Cymru bob blwyddyn. Dyna 1 biliwn o funudau, a pholisi yr amcangyfrifir ei fod yn costio hyd at £9 biliwn i economi Cymru. Ac ar ôl hynny oll, mae marwolaethau ar y ffyrdd yng Nghymru yn dal i gynyddu ar draws y gwahanol barthau cyflymder. Nawr, Weinidog, mae pob un o’r marwolaethau hynny yn drasiedi. Mae diogelwch ffyrdd yn haeddu strategaeth sy’n fwy na dim ond newid arwyddion ffyrdd. Am flynyddoedd, pan oedd Llafur mewn Llywodraeth, cefnogodd eich plaid yr ymagwedd unllygeidiog hon. Fe wnaethoch ei hamddiffyn, fe wnaethoch ei chefnogi, a nawr, mae'r data'n dweud wrthym yn amlwg nad yw'n gweithio. Felly, Weinidog Cabinet, a wnewch chi wrando o'r diwedd ar y data a'r cannoedd o filoedd o bobl sy'n parhau i siarad yn erbyn y polisi a dod â'r arbrawf hwn i ben?

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_welsh: 1. Cwestiynau i’r Gweinidog Cabinet dros Fenter, Cysylltedd ac Ynni
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 1. Questions to the Cabinet Minister for Enterprise, Connectivity and Energy

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_welsh: 1. Cwestiynau i’r Gweinidog Cabinet dros Fenter, Cysylltedd ac Ynni
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 1. Questions to the Cabinet Minister for Enterprise, Connectivity and Energy

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_welsh: 1. Cwestiynau i’r Gweinidog Cabinet dros Fenter, Cysylltedd ac Ynni
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 1. Questions to the Cabinet Minister for Enterprise, Connectivity and Energy
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim: I hesitate to thank you for the question, Jason, but I will do out of courtesy. At the business statement last week, you were reminded to use data carefully, and you used the same data now as you used then. This data doesn't relate to 20 mph. Let's give you the actual data: in 2025, there were 1,469 collisions on roads with 20 mph and 30 mph speed limits combined, which is 2 per cent higher than in 2024, when there were 1,445. But it is the second lowest annual number ever recorded in Wales. So, this proves that, when we've reduced speed limits, it's actually reduced collisions. And I've heard it from people over the other side of the Siambr, and I appreciate it. This saves children's lives. This is a policy that this Government supports. We recognise there were ways we could have done it better; we talked about that throughout the last term, and I think we'd say the same thing again. However, we've got to make sure we follow the evidence, and when the evidence gets polluted by words that aren't actually true, it distorts things. The one thing that I'm sure that I'm going to make sure I do is that I am evidence led; I'm not going to be just led by rhetoric that is from the benches behind.
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated: Rwy'n petruso cyn diolch i chi am eich cwestiwn, Jason, ond fe wnaf hynny allan o gwrteisi. Yn y datganiad busnes yr wythnos diwethaf, cawsoch eich atgoffa i ddefnyddio data'n ofalus, ac fe ddefnyddioch chi yr un data heddiw ag y gwnaethoch bryd hynny. Nid oes a wnelo'r data hwn ag 20 mya. Gadewch inni roi'r data cywir i chi: yn 2025, roedd 1,469 o wrthdrawiadau ar ffyrdd gyda therfynau cyflymder 20 mya a 30 mya gyda'i gilydd, sydd 2 y cant yn uwch nag yn 2024, pan fu 1,445. Ond dyma'r nifer blynyddol isaf ond un a gofnodwyd yng Nghymru erioed. Felly, mae hyn yn profi, pan ydym wedi lleihau terfynau cyflymder, fod hynny wedi lleihau gwrthdrawiadau. Ac rwyf wedi'i glywed gan bobl ar yr ochr draw i'r Siambr, ac rwy'n ei werthfawrogi. Mae hyn yn achub bywydau plant. Mae hwn yn bolisi y mae'r Llywodraeth hon yn ei gefnogi. Rydym yn cydnabod bod ffyrdd y gallem fod wedi'i wneud yn well; buom yn siarad am hynny drwy gydol tymor y Senedd ddiwethaf, ac rwy'n credu y byddem yn dweud yr un peth eto. Fodd bynnag, rhaid inni sicrhau ein bod yn dilyn y dystiolaeth, a phan fydd y dystiolaeth yn cael ei llygru gan eiriau nad ydynt yn wir mewn gwirionedd, mae'n ystumio pethau. Yr un peth rwy'n siŵr y byddaf yn sicrhau fy mod yn ei wneud yw cael fy arwain gan dystiolaeth; nid wyf am gael fy arwain gan rethreg oddi ar y meinciau y tu ôl i mi.

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_welsh: 1. Cwestiynau i’r Gweinidog Cabinet dros Fenter, Cysylltedd ac Ynni
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 1. Questions to the Cabinet Minister for Enterprise, Connectivity and Energy
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim:
I'm pretty sure I heard the data tell me there that accidents were going up, but that's the data for you.

Cabinet Minister, you can dispute all the figures you like, but you can't dispute your party's own record. This goes far beyond the 20 mph default limit. For years, major road projects have been frozen, cancelled or ruled out while congestion's got worse and motorists have been left in traffic up and down Wales. Your own leader made his priorities perfectly clear during the election campaign. He said that Plaid would keep the default limit and that it would not be reviewed. So, let us be clear: while we accept that this is a policy that you inherited from the previous Government, it's an approach you actively supported. You spent years telling the people of Wales that this was all about safety, when in fact, as most people know, up and down the country, it was all about the pursuit of damaging net-zero dogma. Absolutely. Without the proper infrastructure investment, frustrated Welsh motorists would have no choice but to use public transport—isn't that right, Minister? So, rather than punishing motorists as a transport strategy, will you actually invest in the proper road infrastructure that Wales actually needs?
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated:
Rwy'n eithaf siŵr fy mod wedi clywed y data'n dweud bod damweiniau'n cynyddu, ond dyna'r data i chi.

Weinidog Cabinet, gallwch herio'r holl ffigurau a fynnwch, ond ni allwch herio hanes eich plaid eich hun. Mae hyn yn mynd ymhell y tu hwnt i'r terfyn 20 mya diofyn. Ers blynyddoedd, mae prosiectau ffyrdd mawr wedi cael eu rhewi, eu canslo neu eu diystyru tra bo tagfeydd wedi gwaethygu a modurwyr wedi cael eu gadael mewn traffig ledled Cymru. Fe wnaeth eich arweinydd eich hun ei flaenoriaethau'n berffaith glir yn yr ymgyrch etholiadol. Dywedodd y byddai Plaid Cymru yn cadw'r terfyn diofyn ac na fyddai'n cael ei adolygu. Felly, gadewch inni fod yn glir: er ein bod yn derbyn bod hwn yn bolisi a etifeddwyd gan y Llywodraeth flaenorol, mae'n ddull y gwnaethoch chi ei gefnogi'n weithredol. Fe wnaethoch chi dreulio blynyddoedd yn dweud wrth bobl Cymru fod hyn oll yn ymwneud â diogelwch, er ei fod, mewn gwirionedd, fel y gŵyr y rhan fwyaf o bobl ledled y wlad, yn ymwneud â mynd ar drywydd dogma sero net niweidiol. Yn sicr. Heb y buddsoddiad seilwaith priodol, ni fyddai gan fodurwyr rhwystredig Cymru unrhyw ddewis ond defnyddio trafnidiaeth gyhoeddus—onid yw hynny'n iawn, Weinidog? Felly, yn hytrach na chosbi modurwyr fel strategaeth drafnidiaeth, a wnewch chi fuddsoddi yn y seilwaith ffyrdd priodol y mae Cymru ei angen mewn gwirionedd?

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_welsh: 1. Cwestiynau i’r Gweinidog Cabinet dros Fenter, Cysylltedd ac Ynni
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 1. Questions to the Cabinet Minister for Enterprise, Connectivity and Energy
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim: Do you know, it's great when you see young people in the Chamber looking down, and looking down at what we're talking about today? It's with them in mind that I support this policy, because, ultimately, this is not about dogma, this is about safety and particularly children's safety. So, this is something that this Government supports; I think it sounds like it's got support from across other parts of the Siambr. Because, when it comes to dogma, there's no party more interested in dogma than the party behind me when they're talking about things like this. Ultimately, I care more about those children who are up there than I do about answering questions that are like this.
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated: Wyddoch chi, mae'n wych pan welwch bobl ifanc yn y Siambr yn edrych i lawr, ac yn edrych i lawr ar yr hyn y siaradwn amdano heddiw? Gyda nhw mewn golwg rwy'n cefnogi'r polisi hwn, oherwydd yn y pen draw, nid oes a wnelo hyn â dogma, mae a wnelo â diogelwch ac yn enwedig diogelwch plant. Felly, mae hyn yn rhywbeth y mae'r Llywodraeth hon yn ei gefnogi; rwy'n credu ei bod yn swnio fel pe bai cefnogaeth iddo o rannau eraill o'r Siambr. Oherwydd o ran dogma, nid oes unrhyw blaid a chanddi fwy o ddiddordeb mewn dogma na'r blaid y tu ôl i mi pan fyddant yn siarad am bethau fel hyn. Yn y pen draw, rwy'n poeni mwy am y plant sydd i fyny yno nag am ateb cwestiynau fel hyn.

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_welsh: 1. Cwestiynau i’r Gweinidog Cabinet dros Fenter, Cysylltedd ac Ynni
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 1. Questions to the Cabinet Minister for Enterprise, Connectivity and Energy
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim: Oh, you don't care about answering questions from an elected Member. Shocking.
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated: O, nid ydych yn poeni am ateb cwestiynau gan Aelod etholedig. Syfrdanol.

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_welsh: 1. Cwestiynau i’r Gweinidog Cabinet dros Fenter, Cysylltedd ac Ynni
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 1. Questions to the Cabinet Minister for Enterprise, Connectivity and Energy
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim: Another cop out. But the good news is we also care about young people. We want to make sure they have jobs well into the future and our economy thrives. Absolutely. Now, in June, you stood in this Chamber and made a very clear commitment to review the position on the M4 relief road. You said this would not be another review that kicks the can down the road—the can would likely end up in a traffic jam anyway. You said you would return to the Senedd early in autumn with your Government's way forward. Well, Cabinet Minister, rather depressingly, it is autumn. You ruled out a completely viable black route, but the people sitting in congestion around Newport every day don't know what this Government is going to do about the traffic. So, it's time to come clean. Before the election, your party promised a solution on the M4. But I know, and you know, that you have nothing. You were just trying to waste time while you figure it all out at the last minute. In fact, you've taken so long, we've done the work for you. We've revised the costings for the M4 relief road, and £2.8 billion is the updated cost. We are more than happy to continue the work, secure the funding, take over your brief and get the job done ourselves. So, Minister, can you tell us what is your solution to the congestion on the M4? Diolch.
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated: Osgoi'r cwestiwn unwaith eto. Ond y newyddion da yw ein bod ninnau hefyd yn poeni am bobl ifanc. Rydym eisiau sicrhau bod ganddynt swyddi ymhell i'r dyfodol a bod ein heconomi'n ffynnu. Yn sicr. Nawr, ym mis Mehefin, fe wnaethoch chi sefyll yn y Siambr hon a gwneud ymrwymiad clir iawn i adolygu'r sefyllfa ar ffordd liniaru'r M4. Fe ddywedoch chi na fyddai hwn yn adolygiad arall a fyddai'n gohirio'r broblem. Fe ddywedoch chi y byddech chi'n dychwelyd i'r Senedd yn gynnar yn yr hydref gyda ffordd ymlaen eich Llywodraeth. Wel, Weinidog Cabinet, yn eithaf digalon, mae'n hydref. Fe wnaethoch chi ddiystyru llwybr du cwbl hyfyw, ond nid yw'r bobl sy'n eistedd mewn tagfeydd o amgylch Casnewydd bob dydd yn gwybod beth y mae'r Llywodraeth hon yn mynd i'w wneud ynglŷn â'r traffig. Felly, mae'n bryd dweud y gwir. Cyn yr etholiad, addawodd eich plaid ateb ar yr M4. Ond rwy'n gwybod, ac rydych chithau'n gwybod, nad oes gennych unrhyw beth. Roeddech chi'n gwastraffu amser cyn ceisio datrys y cyfan ar y funud olaf. Mewn gwirionedd, rydych chi wedi cymryd cymaint o amser, rydym wedi gwneud y gwaith ar eich rhan. Rydym wedi diwygio'r costau ar gyfer ffordd liniaru'r M4, a £2.8 biliwn yw'r gost ddiweddaraf. Rydym yn fwy na pharod i barhau â'r gwaith, sicrhau'r cyllid, cymryd y cyfrifoldeb dros eich briff a chael y gwaith wedi'i wneud ein hunain. Felly, Weinidog, a allwch ddweud wrthym beth yw eich ateb chi i'r tagfeydd ar yr M4? Diolch.

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_welsh: 1. Cwestiynau i’r Gweinidog Cabinet dros Fenter, Cysylltedd ac Ynni
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 1. Questions to the Cabinet Minister for Enterprise, Connectivity and Energy

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_welsh: 1. Cwestiynau i’r Gweinidog Cabinet dros Fenter, Cysylltedd ac Ynni
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 1. Questions to the Cabinet Minister for Enterprise, Connectivity and Energy
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim: The Member is well aware that we're going to be coming back to this Siambr on 6 October with an update based on evidence. The reason we want evidence is to make sure that we make the right decisions and we don't—. We're not kicking the can down the road, we're actually making the right decisions based on what the evidence tells us. As he knows, as do other transport spokespeople in this room, I've made sure that I'm going to share that evidence ahead of this meeting, so we'll be in the position that this Siambr will be able to talk about things that actually are important, that actually matter. Because then, hopefully, we'll come to some consensus. The M4 isn't straightforward. Let's be honest. The M4, as a road, was built as part of the infrastructure around Newport. So, it's not just about the M4—this is about intra-Newport issues as much as it is about the M4. That's what this Government is going to do. I look forward to debating that on 6 October when we can talk about evidence.
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated: Mae'r Aelod yn gwbl ymwybodol ein bod yn mynd i ddod yn ôl i'r Siambr hon ar 6 Hydref gyda diweddariad yn seiliedig ar dystiolaeth. Y rheswm pam ein bod eisiau tystiolaeth yw er mwyn sicrhau ein bod yn gwneud y penderfyniadau cywir ac nad ydym—. Nid ydym yn gohirio'r broblem, rydym yn gwneud y penderfyniadau cywir ar sail yr hyn y mae'r dystiolaeth yn ei ddweud wrthym. Fel y gŵyr ef, ac fel y gŵyr y llefarwyr trafnidiaeth eraill yn yr ystafell hon, rwyf wedi sicrhau y byddaf yn rhannu'r dystiolaeth honno cyn y cyfarfod hwn, felly byddwn mewn sefyllfa lle bydd y Siambr yn gallu siarad am bethau sy'n bwysig, sydd o wir bwys. Oherwydd wedyn, gobeithio, fe ddown i rywfaint o gonsensws. Nid yw'r M4 yn syml. Gadewch inni fod yn onest. Adeiladwyd yr M4, fel ffordd, fel rhan o'r seilwaith o amgylch Casnewydd. Felly, mae a wnelo â mwy na'r M4 yn unig—mae a wnelo â materion o fewn Casnewydd i'r un graddau ag y mae a wnelo â'r M4. Dyna y mae'r Llywodraeth hon yn mynd i'w wneud. Edrychaf ymlaen at drafod hynny ar 6 Hydref pan allwn siarad am dystiolaeth.

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_welsh: 1. Cwestiynau i’r Gweinidog Cabinet dros Fenter, Cysylltedd ac Ynni
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 1. Questions to the Cabinet Minister for Enterprise, Connectivity and Energy
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim: Llefarydd Llafur Cymru, Shav Taj.
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated: Welsh Labour spokesperson, Shav Taj.

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_welsh: 1. Cwestiynau i’r Gweinidog Cabinet dros Fenter, Cysylltedd ac Ynni
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 1. Questions to the Cabinet Minister for Enterprise, Connectivity and Energy
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim: Minister, data centres, I've written to you about them many a time, and, obviously, they're not new, but their use—principally because of AI and its expansion—is going to be important. There are critical challenges around that, potentially opportunities as well, in terms of jobs and growth and all the rest of it. To that end, it was really good to have a response from you. When I wrote to you, you responded about a new strategic policy framework for data centres in Wales. I think that's really critical, and of course it would be great to now, I guess, understand from you what the Government's intentions are on the basis of that framework. Will you commit that any framework will ensure positive community and environmental impact as being a guiding force? I'm sure that you would, hopefully, agree with me that we need to ensure that communities that have that infrastructure do then actually receive tangible local benefits through good jobs, good apprenticeships and genuine community wealth building.
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated: Weinidog, canolfannau data, rwyf wedi ysgrifennu atoch amdanynt sawl gwaith, ac yn amlwg, nid ydynt yn newydd, ond mae eu defnydd—yn bennaf oherwydd deallusrwydd artiffisial a'i gynnydd—yn mynd i fod yn bwysig. Mae heriau hollbwysig ynghlwm wrth hynny, cyfleoedd o bosibl hefyd, o ran swyddi a thwf a phopeth arall. I'r perwyl hwnnw, roedd yn dda iawn cael ymateb gennych. Pan ysgrifennais atoch, fe wnaethoch chi ymateb am fframwaith polisi strategol newydd ar gyfer canolfannau data yng Nghymru. Credaf fod hynny'n hollbwysig, ac wrth gwrs, byddai'n wych deall gennych nawr beth yw bwriadau'r Llywodraeth ar sail y fframwaith hwnnw. A wnewch chi ymrwymo y bydd unrhyw fframwaith yn sicrhau effaith gadarnhaol ar y gymuned a'r amgylchedd fel egwyddor arweiniol? Rwy'n siŵr y byddech yn cytuno â mi fod angen inni sicrhau bod cymunedau sydd â'r seilwaith hwnnw yn cael buddion lleol pendant wedyn drwy swyddi da, prentisiaethau da ac adeiladu cyfoeth cymunedol gwirioneddol.

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_welsh: 1. Cwestiynau i’r Gweinidog Cabinet dros Fenter, Cysylltedd ac Ynni
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 1. Questions to the Cabinet Minister for Enterprise, Connectivity and Energy
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim: I'm really grateful to the Member, not just for writing to me, as she's described, but also for raising this subject here in the Siambr, which gives me an opportunity to address some of the issues that are relevant to this area. As she's aware, we have commissioned work that is ongoing in this area. It's important to acknowledge that with the huge growth of data centres, related digital infrastructure and the wider context, of course, of AI, edge computing and related technologies, we do need to have a robust policy framework that is futureproofed and that also recognises the need to enable us to have the advantages that can flow from the investments that are happening in digital infrastructure across the world but to do so in a way that balances those with the legitimate concerns that people have at a community level and more broadly in terms of energy use, in terms of water, in terms of land use et cetera. So, we will be setting this out as soon as we can so that we can have that discussion across the Siambr and more widely across civil society in Wales.
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated: Rwy'n ddiolchgar iawn i'r Aelod, nid yn unig am ysgrifennu ataf, fel y mae wedi'i ddisgrifio, ond hefyd am godi'r pwnc hwn yma yn y Siambr, sy'n rhoi cyfle imi fynd i'r afael â rhai o'r materion sy'n berthnasol i'r maes hwn. Fel y gŵyr, rydym wedi comisiynu gwaith sy'n mynd rhagddo yn y maes hwn. Mae'n bwysig cydnabod, gyda thwf enfawr canolfannau data, seilwaith digidol cysylltiedig a chyd-destun ehangach deallusrwydd artiffisial, cyfrifiadura ymylol a thechnolegau cysylltiedig, fod angen fframwaith polisi cadarn arnom sydd wedi'i ddiogelu at y dyfodol ac sydd hefyd yn cydnabod yr angen i'n galluogi i gael y manteision a all ddeillio o'r buddsoddiadau mewn seilwaith digidol ledled y byd, ond i wneud hynny mewn ffordd sy'n cydbwyso'r rheini â'r pryderon dilys sydd gan bobl ar lefel gymunedol ac yn fwy cyffredinol o ran defnyddio ynni, o ran dŵr, o ran defnydd tir ac ati. Felly, byddwn yn nodi hyn cyn gynted ag y gallwn er mwyn i ni gael y drafodaeth honno ar draws y Siambr ac yn ehangach ar draws cymdeithas sifil yng Nghymru.

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_welsh: 1. Cwestiynau i’r Gweinidog Cabinet dros Fenter, Cysylltedd ac Ynni
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 1. Questions to the Cabinet Minister for Enterprise, Connectivity and Energy
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim: Thank you, Minister. Obviously, we can't have a thriving economy in Wales without stronger connections between jobs, opportunities and communities. That's why the UK Labour Government invested £14 billion in Welsh rail, and Cardiff parkway is a really important part of that strategy. My constituents in St Mellons know that the construction is going to take time, and they're going to need some reassurances about the direct benefit to the community, of course, but every day some of that news—. They're still waiting. So, can you now update us on when we will see the first shovel in the ground on Cardiff parkway, in my constituency of Caerdydd Ffynnon Taf?
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated: Diolch, Weinidog. Yn amlwg, ni allwn gael economi ffyniannus yng Nghymru heb gysylltiadau cryfach rhwng swyddi, cyfleoedd a chymunedau. Dyna pam y buddsoddodd Llywodraeth Lafur y DU £14 biliwn yn rheilffyrdd Cymru, ac mae parcffordd Caerdydd yn rhan bwysig iawn o'r strategaeth honno. Mae fy etholwyr yn Llaneirwg yn gwybod y bydd yr adeiladu'n cymryd amser, a bydd angen rhywfaint o sicrwydd arnynt am y budd uniongyrchol i'r gymuned, wrth gwrs, ond bob dydd, mae rhywfaint o'r newyddion hwnnw—. Maent yn dal i aros. Felly, a allwch chi roi'r wybodaeth ddiweddaraf i ni nawr ynglŷn â pryd y gwelwn y rhaw gyntaf yn y ddaear ar barcffordd Caerdydd yn fy etholaeth i, Caerdydd Ffynnon Taf?

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_welsh: 1. Cwestiynau i’r Gweinidog Cabinet dros Fenter, Cysylltedd ac Ynni
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 1. Questions to the Cabinet Minister for Enterprise, Connectivity and Energy
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim: I'm grateful to the Member for that question as well. We were wondering whether we could do a little bit of choreography. But I think that the key here, and obviously we're aware of that specific opportunity, is we're keen to see investment in our railway infrastructure the length and breadth of Wales, including in Cardiff. The one thing that we need, and maybe we can work together on this, is to turn that £14 billion promise that, you know—. The promise was very welcome, but what we need now is to turn that into an action plan with budgetary commitments and a timetable. And then we'll not only be able to deliver Cardiff parkway and wider investment across Cardiff and south-east Wales, but the length and breadth of Wales. So, let's work together on that.
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated: Rwy'n ddiolchgar i'r Aelod am y cwestiwn hwnnw hefyd. Roeddem yn meddwl tybed a allem wneud rhywfaint o goreograffi. Ond rwy'n credu mai'r hyn sy'n allweddol yma, ac yn amlwg, rydym yn ymwybodol o'r cyfle penodol hwnnw, yw ein bod yn awyddus i weld buddsoddiad yn ein seilwaith rheilffyrdd ledled Cymru, gan gynnwys yng Nghaerdydd. Yr un peth sydd ei angen arnom, ac efallai y gallwn weithio gyda'n gilydd ar hyn, yw troi'r addewid o £14 biliwn sydd, wyddoch chi—. Roedd yr addewid hwnnw i'w groesawu, ond yr hyn sydd ei angen arnom nawr yw troi hynny'n gynllun gweithredu gydag ymrwymiadau cyllidebol ac amserlen. Ac yna byddwn nid yn unig yn gallu agor gorsaf parcffordd Caerdydd a sicrhau buddsoddiad ehangach ar draws Caerdydd a'r de-ddwyrain, ond ledled Cymru hefyd. Felly, gadewch inni weithio gyda'n gilydd ar hynny.

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_welsh: 1. Cwestiynau i’r Gweinidog Cabinet dros Fenter, Cysylltedd ac Ynni
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 1. Questions to the Cabinet Minister for Enterprise, Connectivity and Energy

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_welsh: 1. Cwestiynau i’r Gweinidog Cabinet dros Fenter, Cysylltedd ac Ynni
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 1. Questions to the Cabinet Minister for Enterprise, Connectivity and Energy
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim: Llefarydd y Ceidwadwyr Cymreig, Janet Finch-Saunders.
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated: Welsh Conservative spokesperson, Janet Finch-Saunders.

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_welsh: 1. Cwestiynau i’r Gweinidog Cabinet dros Fenter, Cysylltedd ac Ynni
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 1. Questions to the Cabinet Minister for Enterprise, Connectivity and Energy
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim: Diolch, Ddirprwy Lywydd. And pen-blwydd hapus, Cabinet Secretary. Minister, there is potentially a very expensive problem with the Global Centre of Rail Excellence. Now, my colleague Andrew R.T. Davies yesterday raised it, and I'm not sure that the answer that you gave yesterday actually addressed the very fundamental point of such an amount of wasted taxpayers' money. When the Welsh Government announced this scheme, the Global Centre of Rail Excellence—sounds good, doesn't it—it explicitly stated that Celtic Energy would gift all the land necessary for the project, yet the site was subsequently described as having been purchased by GCRE, and it was transferred before restoration of the former Nant Helen opencast mine had been completed. So, will you tell us today, plainly, was the land gifted or purchased? If it was purchased, how much did GCRE pay, and what restoration liabilities did the previous and now this current Welsh Government-owned company take on when it acquired the site? Most importantly, if the money available for restoration is not enough to finish the job, exactly who does pick up the bill, Celtic Energy or the Welsh taxpayer?
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated: Diolch, Ddirprwy Lywydd. A phen-blwydd hapus, Ysgrifennydd y Cabinet. Weinidog, mae problem ddrud iawn o bosibl gyda'r Ganolfan Ragoriaeth Fyd-Eang ar gyfer Rheilffyrdd. Nawr, cododd fy nghyd-Aelod Andrew R.T. Davies y mater ddoe, ac nid wyf yn siŵr a aeth yr ateb a roesoch ddoe i'r afael mewn gwirionedd â'r pwynt sylfaenol iawn o faint o arian trethdalwyr sydd wedi'i wastraffu. Pan gyhoeddwyd y cynllun hwn gan Lywodraeth Cymru, y Ganolfan Ragoriaeth Fyd-Eang ar gyfer Rheilffyrdd—mae'n swnio'n dda, onid yw—nododd yn benodol y byddai Celtic Energy yn rhoi'r holl dir angenrheidiol yn rhodd ar gyfer y prosiect, ond wedi hynny, nodwyd bod y safle wedi'i brynu gan y Ganolfan Ragoriaeth Fyd-Eang ar gyfer Rheilffyrdd, a chafodd ei drosglwyddo cyn i'r gwaith o adfer hen fwynglawdd brig Nant Helen gael ei gwblhau. Felly, a wnewch chi ddweud wrthym heddiw, yn glir, a gafodd y tir ei roi'n rhodd neu ei brynu? Os cafodd ei brynu, faint a dalodd y Ganolfan Ragoriaeth Fyd-Eang ar gyfer Rheilffyrdd, a pha rwymedigaethau adfer a ysgwyddwyd gan y cwmni blaenorol a'r cwmni sydd nawr yn eiddo i Lywodraeth Cymru pan gaffaelodd y safle? Yn bwysicaf oll, os nad yw'r arian sydd ar gael ar gyfer y gwaith adfer yn ddigon i orffen y gwaith, pwy'n union sy'n talu'r bil, Celtic Energy neu drethdalwyr Cymru?

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_welsh: 1. Cwestiynau i’r Gweinidog Cabinet dros Fenter, Cysylltedd ac Ynni
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 1. Questions to the Cabinet Minister for Enterprise, Connectivity and Energy
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim:
I'm grateful; thank you for your birthday wishes. In relation to the specifics on GCRE, there were some specific questions, and, if the Member is happy, I would prefer to take those back so we can ensure that, whatever information we can, we provide accurately, because I don't have all of that at my fingertips here.

But what I can say is that we as a Government reviewed the situation, we commissioned specialist advice in terms of where we are now, as the First Minister was saying, in terms of the opportunity. We've received that specialist advice, and we are now in the process of reviewing and discussing with other potential investors what the potential is. There is an incredibly important employment site here, and we're looking both at the Global Centre of Rail Excellence option, but looking at it in the round as well.
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated:
Rwy'n ddiolchgar; diolch am eich dymuniadau pen-blwydd. O ran y manylion ynglŷn â'r Ganolfan Ragoriaeth Fyd-Eang ar gyfer Rheilffyrdd, roedd rhai cwestiynau penodol, ac os yw'r Aelod yn fodlon, buasai'n well gennyf gymryd rhywfaint o amser i'w hystyried fel y gallwn sicrhau, pa bynnag wybodaeth y gallwn ei darparu, y byddwn yn ei darparu'n gywir, gan nad yw'r holl wybodaeth honno yma wrth law gennyf.

Ond yr hyn y gallaf ei ddweud yw ein bod ni fel Llywodraeth wedi adolygu'r sefyllfa, fe wnaethom gomisiynu cyngor arbenigol o ran ble rydym arni nawr, fel roedd y Prif Weinidog yn ei ddweud, o ran y cyfle. Rydym wedi cael y cyngor arbenigol hwnnw, ac rydym bellach yn y broses o adolygu a thrafod beth yw'r potensial gyda buddsoddwyr posibl eraill. Mae safle cyflogaeth hynod bwysig yma, ac rydym yn edrych ar y Ganolfan Ragoriaeth Fyd-Eang ar gyfer Rheilffyrdd fel opsiwn, ond yn edrych ar y sefyllfa yn ei chyfanrwydd hefyd.

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_welsh: 1. Cwestiynau i’r Gweinidog Cabinet dros Fenter, Cysylltedd ac Ynni
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 1. Questions to the Cabinet Minister for Enterprise, Connectivity and Energy
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim:
Diolch. I hope you can answer this one. Minister, the original plan was that £70 million of public money would help unlock around £330 million of private investment. For years, we were told there was serious private sector interest. GCRE talked about credible bidders and international interest, even from the middle east and America. And as recently as March last year, the First Minister at the time told this Senedd that GCRE was in detailed discussions with a potential funder, yet the private investment still hasn't materialised and the rail testing centre still hasn't been built.

So, what exactly went wrong? Was there ever an investor genuinely prepared to put up the money needed to build the project, and, if so, why did they walk away? Because, at this moment in time, it does look as though your Government has inherited a large hole in the ground, a project nobody is prepared to invest in, and, potentially, a very large bill for putting the site back as it was. How much more taxpayers' money are you prepared to put into this scheme? Diolch yn fawr.
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated:
Diolch. Rwy'n gobeithio y gallwch ateb yr un hwn. Weinidog, y cynllun gwreiddiol oedd y byddai £70 miliwn o arian cyhoeddus yn helpu i ddatgloi oddeutu £330 miliwn o fuddsoddiad preifat. Am flynyddoedd, dywedwyd wrthym fod diddordeb sylweddol gan y sector preifat. Siaradodd y Ganolfan Ragoriaeth Fyd-Eang ar gyfer Rheilffyrdd am gynigwyr credadwy a diddordeb rhyngwladol, hyd yn oed o'r dwyrain canol ac America. Ac mor ddiweddar â mis Mawrth y llynedd, dywedodd y Prif Weinidog ar y pryd wrth y Senedd hon fod y Ganolfan Ragoriaeth Fyd-Eang ar gyfer Rheilffyrdd mewn trafodaethau manwl gyda chyllidwr posibl, ond nid oes unrhyw fuddsoddiad preifat wedi'i wneud o hyd, ac nid yw'r ganolfan brofi rheilffyrdd wedi'i hadeiladu eto.

Felly, beth yn union a aeth o'i le? A fu buddsoddwr erioed a oedd yn wirioneddol barod i ddarparu'r arian sydd ei angen i adeiladu'r prosiect, ac os felly, pam y gwnaethant droi eu cefnau? Oherwydd ar hyn o bryd, mae'n edrych fel pe bai eich Llywodraeth wedi etifeddu twll mawr yn y ddaear, prosiect nad oes unrhyw un yn barod i fuddsoddi ynddo, ac o bosibl, bil mawr iawn am roi'r safle'n ôl fel yr oedd. Faint yn rhagor o arian trethdalwyr rydych chi'n barod i'w wario ar y cynllun hwn? Diolch yn fawr.

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_welsh: 1. Cwestiynau i’r Gweinidog Cabinet dros Fenter, Cysylltedd ac Ynni
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 1. Questions to the Cabinet Minister for Enterprise, Connectivity and Energy
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim: Thank you for that further question in this area. There's not much, really, I can add usefully at this stage. I'm sure the Member will be mindful of the fact that we need to actually drill down into the detail, look at the potential interest that has been expressed by an investor, and then make a decision in the full possession of all of that information that delivers the best public value that we can, both in economic and employment terms, in a very, very important region of Wales, which is deserving of our support to the full extent that is possible. And once we have that information, we will make a decision and we will bring that decision, of course, back to the Siambr.
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated: Diolch am eich cwestiwn pellach ar hyn. Nid oes llawer y gallaf ei ychwanegu'n ddefnyddiol ar hyn o bryd mewn gwirionedd. Rwy'n siŵr y bydd yr Aelod yn ymwybodol o'r ffaith bod angen inni ymchwilio i'r manylion, edrych ar y diddordeb posibl a fynegwyd gan fuddsoddwr, ac yna, gyda'r holl wybodaeth honno, gwneud penderfyniad sy'n darparu'r gwerth cyhoeddus gorau, yn economaidd ac o ran cyflogaeth, mewn rhanbarth pwysig iawn yng Nghymru, sy'n haeddu ein cefnogaeth i'r graddau mwyaf sy'n bosibl. A phan fydd y wybodaeth honno gennym, byddwn yn gwneud penderfyniad a byddwn yn dod â'r penderfyniad hwnnw yn ôl i'r Siambr wrth gwrs.

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim: 3. Pa rôl fydd prosiectau ynni cymunedol yn ei chwarae yn nhrawsnewidiad Cymru i sero net? OQ64557
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated: 3. What role will community energy projects play in Wales's transition to net zero? OQ64557

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_welsh: 1. Cwestiynau i’r Gweinidog Cabinet dros Fenter, Cysylltedd ac Ynni
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 1. Questions to the Cabinet Minister for Enterprise, Connectivity and Energy
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim: Bydd ein strategaeth ynni genedlaethol yn cydnabod rôl hanfodol ynni cymunedol wrth gyflawni sero net. Bydd cwmni ynni cyhoeddus Cymru yn helpu i gyflawni’r uchelgais honno, gan gynyddu nifer y prosiectau ynni cymunedol, gosod systemau ynni adnewyddadwy a chyfleusterau storio a'u defnyddio i ddarparu pŵer a gwres am gost is i bobl.
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated: Our national energy strategy will recognise the vital role of community energy in achieving net zero. The Welsh public energy company will help unlock that ambition, scaling up the number of community energy projects, installing renewables and storage and using them to provide lower cost power and heat to people.

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_welsh: 1. Cwestiynau i’r Gweinidog Cabinet dros Fenter, Cysylltedd ac Ynni
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 1. Questions to the Cabinet Minister for Enterprise, Connectivity and Energy
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim: Diolch yn fawr iawn. Mae'n wych clywed eich bod chi o'r un farn â fi fod gan ynni cymunedol ran hollbwysig i'w chwarae wrth inni symud tuag at ein huchelgais o Gymru sero net. Wrth gwrs, wrth galon ein hegwyddorion wrth inni fynd ati i ddatblygu prosiectau ynni cymunedol yw eu bod nhw'n cyd-fynd â'r anghenion yn lleol, ac mae'n bwysig sicrhau bod y broses cynllunio yn adlewyrchu hynny. Enghraifft berffaith o ddatblygiad diwydiannol sydd yn mynd yn gwbl groes i'n hegwyddorion ni yn fy etholaeth i yw'r cynllun canolfan ddata Menai ar hen safle Ferodo yn ardal Caernarfon. Mae'n brosiect fydd yn llyncu llwythi o ynni a dŵr, yn cael effaith ddinistriol ar fywyd natur ac yn achosi llygredd sŵn a golau yn lleol. Ond, yn fwy na dim, mae graddfa anferthol y prosiect yn golygu y bydd yn siŵr o ddifetha ein tirwedd a'n golygfeydd yn lleol, gan gynnig ychydig iawn o fanteision yn lleol. Felly, sut y gallwch sicrhau nad yw cyflenwad ynni canolfannau data yn cael effaith negyddol ar yr ardal leol?
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated: Thank you very much. It's excellent to hear that you share my view that community energy has a crucial role to play as we move towards our ambition of a net-zero Wales. Of course, at the heart of our principles as we develop community energy projects is that they align with local need, and it's important to ensure that the planning process reflects that. A perfect example of an industrial development that is contrary to our principles in my constituency is the Menai data centre scheme on the former Ferodo site near Caernarfon. It's a project that will swallow great amounts of energy and water, will have a damaging impact on wildlife and will cause sound and light pollution locally. But, more than anything, the huge scale of the project means that it will be sure to destroy our local landscapes and views, while offering very few local benefits. So, how can you ensure that the energy supply for data centres doesn't have a negative impact on the local area?

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_welsh: 1. Cwestiynau i’r Gweinidog Cabinet dros Fenter, Cysylltedd ac Ynni
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 1. Questions to the Cabinet Minister for Enterprise, Connectivity and Energy
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim: Dwi'n ddiolchgar i'r Aelod am y cwestiwn atodol. Rydych chi'n mynd, dwi'n credu, at hanfod egwyddorion ein polisi economaidd, hynny yw, fod datblygiadau o ran ein heconomi ni neu o ran ein system ynni ni yn gorfod cael eu cynllunio er budd pobl Cymru. Rydyn ni wedi gweld yn ein gorffennol fel cenedl, wrth gwrs, y gwrthwyneb yn digwydd, a datblygiadau'n digwydd ar draul buddiannau pobl leol. Dydyn ni ddim yn barod i weld yr un camgymeriad yn digwydd eto. Felly, dyna pam rydyn ni'n rhoi pwyslais ar ynni cymunedol. Rydyn ni'n rhoi ymrwymiad o ran sicrhau isafswm, o leiaf, mewn prosiectau mawr o ran perchnogaeth leol, ac yn y cyd-destun penodol y gwnaethoch chi gyfeirio ato fe o ran canolfannau data, os caf i ategu'r hyn a ddywedais i'n gynharach, mi fyddwn ni fel Llywodraeth yn dod â fframwaith polisi gerbron sy'n mynd i'r afael â'r ofnau digon dealladwy ar draws Cymru lle mae yna argymhellion o ran canolfannau data sydd ddim yn rhoi'r priod ystyriaeth i fuddiannau pobl leol na'r amgylchedd lleol.
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated: I'm grateful to the Member for that supplementary question. I think that you get to the core of the principles of our economic policy, namely that developments in terms of our economy or our energy system have to be planned for the benefit of the people of Wales. We have seen in our past as a nation, of course, the opposite of that happening, and developments taking place at the expense of local interests. We're not willing to see the same mistakes being made again. So, that's why we put an emphasis on community energy. We have made a commitment in terms of ensuring a minimum, at least, in terms of the local ownership of major projects, and in the particular context you referred to in terms of data centres, if I could echo what I said earlier, we as a Government will be bringing a policy framework forward that will address the quite understandable fears that exist across Wales where there are recommendations made in terms of data centres that don't give due consideration to the interests of local people or the local environment.

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_welsh: 1. Cwestiynau i’r Gweinidog Cabinet dros Fenter, Cysylltedd ac Ynni
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 1. Questions to the Cabinet Minister for Enterprise, Connectivity and Energy
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim: Cabinet Minister, there's a world of difference between genuine community energy and simply expecting rural communities to host enormous commercial energy developments. Across Wales, communities are being asked to accept industrial-scale windfarms, pylons and other infrastructure, while too often the electricity profits and the economic benefits flow elsewhere. So, if your Government wants at least 1.5 GW of renewable energy capacity to be locally owned by 2035, will you guarantee that community energy really means community ownership, community consent and tangible benefits for the people who live there, including lower energy costs, rather than simply imposing ever more large-scale development on rural Wales and calling a community benefit fund compensation? Diolch.
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated: Weinidog Cabinet, mae gwahaniaeth enfawr rhwng ynni cymunedol go iawn a dim ond disgwyl i gymunedau gwledig gynnal datblygiadau ynni masnachol enfawr. Ledled Cymru, gofynnir i gymunedau dderbyn ffermydd gwynt ar raddfa ddiwydiannol, peilonau a seilwaith arall, tra bod yr elw o drydan a'r manteision economaidd yn rhy aml yn llifo i rywle arall. Felly, os yw eich Llywodraeth eisiau i o leiaf 1.5 GW o gapasiti ynni adnewyddadwy fod yn eiddo lleol erbyn 2035, a wnewch chi warantu bod ynni cymunedol o ddifrif yn golygu perchnogaeth gymunedol, caniatâd cymunedol a manteision diriaethol i'r bobl sy'n byw yno, gan gynnwys costau ynni is, yn hytrach na dim ond gorfodi mwyfwy o ddatblygiadau mawr ar Gymru wledig a galw cronfa budd cymunedol yn iawndal? Diolch.

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_welsh: 1. Cwestiynau i’r Gweinidog Cabinet dros Fenter, Cysylltedd ac Ynni
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 1. Questions to the Cabinet Minister for Enterprise, Connectivity and Energy
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim: I'm grateful to the Member for his question. As I said a moment ago, I think that building, financing and facilitating community energy that is 100 per cent community owned is an important element of our policy. For larger schemes, we have said that we are committed to mandating a minimum level of community ownership of those schemes. I would say, more broadly, as well, a key principle of our national energy strategy will be taking an approach that I would characterise as more planned in relation to the spatial development of energy, rather than what we've had previously, which is, essentially, a market-led approach, which has led to concerns in communities, legitimate questions, like whether cumulative impact is properly being addressed. So, I think, by taking a planned approach, and getting the balance right between the necessity for decarbonising our energy system, recognising the range of technologies, including onshore renewables and their role in that, but giving confidence to communities as well that this is being done in a planned way, with them, and is not being imposed upon them with little benefit accruing to communities and to the people of Wales.
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated: Rwy'n ddiolchgar i'r Aelod am ei gwestiwn. Fel y dywedais funud yn ôl, rwy'n credu bod adeiladu, ariannu a hwyluso ynni cymunedol sy'n eiddo i'r gymuned 100 y cant yn elfen bwysig o'n polisi. Ar gyfer cynlluniau mwy o faint, rydym wedi dweud ein bod wedi ymrwymo i fynnu isafswm o berchnogaeth gymunedol ar y cynlluniau hynny. Buaswn yn dweud, yn fwy eang, hefyd, mai egwyddor allweddol o'n strategaeth ynni genedlaethol fydd mabwysiadu dull o weithredu y buaswn yn ei ddisgrifio fel un mwy cynlluniedig mewn perthynas â datblygiad gofodol ynni, yn hytrach na'r hyn a gawsom yn flaenorol, sef dull a arweinir gan y farchnad yn y bôn, sydd wedi arwain at bryderon mewn cymunedau, cwestiynau dilys, fel a yw effaith gronnol yn cael ei datrys yn briodol. Felly, mabwysiadu dull cynlluniedig, a chael y cydbwysedd cywir rhwng yr angen i ddatgarboneiddio ein system ynni, gan gydnabod yr ystod o dechnolegau, yn cynnwys ynni adnewyddadwy ar y tir a'u rôl yn hynny, ond rhoi hyder i gymunedau hefyd fod hyn yn cael ei wneud mewn ffordd gynlluniedig, gyda nhw, ac nad yw'n cael ei orfodi arnynt heb fawr o fudd i gymunedau ac i bobl Cymru.
