XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_welsh: 2. Cwestiynau i'r Gweinidog Cabinet dros Addysg a’r Gymraeg
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 2. Questions to the Cabinet Minister for Education and Welsh Language
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim: 7. Pa gynnydd y mae Llywodraeth Cymru wedi'i wneud o ran arolygu cyflwr ystadau ysgolion ledled Cymru? OQ64531
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated: 7. What progress has the Welsh Government made on surveying the condition of school estates across Wales? OQ64531

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_welsh: 2. Cwestiynau i'r Gweinidog Cabinet dros Addysg a’r Gymraeg
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 2. Questions to the Cabinet Minister for Education and Welsh Language
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim: We are committed to improving the condition of the school estate in Wales so that every learner is educated in a safe, sustainable and high-quality environment. To do this, the Welsh Government works in partnership with local authorities, who are responsible for school repairs and maintenance. Condition surveys are used to identify schools in need of the most urgent repairs and upgrades, and we are committed to working with colleagues to ensure the most effective use of resources.
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated: Rydym wedi ymrwymo i wella cyflwr yr ystad ysgolion yng Nghymru fel bod pob dysgwr yn cael ei addysgu mewn amgylchedd diogel, cynaliadwy ac o ansawdd uchel. I wneud hyn, mae Llywodraeth Cymru yn gweithio mewn partneriaeth ag awdurdodau lleol, sy'n gyfrifol am atgyweiriadau a gwaith cynnal a chadw mewn ysgolion. Defnyddir arolygon o gyflwr ysgolion i nodi pa ysgolion sydd angen yr atgyweiriadau a'r uwchraddiadau y mae fwyaf o frys amdanynt, ac rydym wedi ymrwymo i weithio gyda chydweithwyr i sicrhau'r defnydd mwyaf effeithiol o adnoddau.

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_welsh: 2. Cwestiynau i'r Gweinidog Cabinet dros Addysg a’r Gymraeg
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 2. Questions to the Cabinet Minister for Education and Welsh Language

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_welsh: 2. Cwestiynau i'r Gweinidog Cabinet dros Addysg a’r Gymraeg
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 2. Questions to the Cabinet Minister for Education and Welsh Language

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_welsh: 2. Cwestiynau i'r Gweinidog Cabinet dros Addysg a’r Gymraeg
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 2. Questions to the Cabinet Minister for Education and Welsh Language
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim:
A high number of schools across my constituency of Caerdydd Ffynnon Taf are facing a maintenance backlog. Scaffolding has surrounded Roath Park primary since 2021, Marlborough Road primary since 2022 and Albany primary since 2023. The condition of a number of comprehensives is substandard and very close to being further downgraded, including the second-hand Welsh-medium comprehensives ysgol Bro Edern and ysgol Plasmawr.

Most worryingly, parents at Albany Primary School were advised the week before this term started that their children would be sent out to three different schools because of dry rot. This late notice was despite Estyn warning in October 2025 that the site management arrangements at Albany Primary School, and I quote,

'give cause for concern and have been brought to the attention of the local authority.'

What discussions has the Cabinet Minister had with Cardiff Council regarding the condition of their school estate, and the council's response to Estyn in particular, and whether earlier intervention could have avoided Albany primary's closure and the severe disruption caused to pupils' education?
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated:
Mae nifer fawr o ysgolion ar draws fy etholaeth i yng Nghaerdydd Ffynnon Taf yn wynebu ôl-groniad o waith cynnal a chadw. Mae sgaffaldiau wedi amgylchynu Ysgol Gynradd Parc y Rhath ers 2021, Ysgol Gynradd Heol Marlborough ers 2022 ac Ysgol Gynradd Albany ers 2023. Mae cyflwr nifer o ysgolion uwchradd yn is na'r safon ac yn agos iawn at gael eu hisraddio ymhellach, gan gynnwys ysgolion uwchradd cyfun Cymraeg Bro Edern a Phlasmawr.

Yn fwyaf pryderus, cynghorwyd rhieni Ysgol Gynradd Albany yr wythnos cyn dechrau'r tymor hwn y byddai eu plant yn cael eu hanfon allan i dair ysgol wahanol oherwydd pydredd sych. Daeth yr hysbysiad hwyr hwn er i Estyn rybuddio ym mis Hydref 2025 fod y trefniadau rheoli safle yn Ysgol Gynradd Albany,

'yn achos pryder ac wedi cael eu dwyn i sylw'r awdurdod lleol.'

Pa drafodaethau y mae'r Gweinidog Cabinet wedi'u cael gyda Chyngor Caerdydd ynglŷn â chyflwr eu hystad ysgolion, ac ymateb y cyngor i Estyn yn enwedig, ac a allai ymyrraeth gynharach fod wedi atal Ysgol Gynradd Albany rhag gorfod cau a'r aflonyddwch difrifol a achoswyd i addysg disgyblion?

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_welsh: 2. Cwestiynau i'r Gweinidog Cabinet dros Addysg a’r Gymraeg
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 2. Questions to the Cabinet Minister for Education and Welsh Language
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim: Thank you. The Welsh Government only holds very high-level information on school conditions, so I think this is an issue that will need to be pursued with the local authority. But I will say that we did commit to conducting that survey of school buildings, and that work is continuing now, to recognise the fact that we know that there is a significant issue across Wales with school buildings. We are going to prioritise those that are categorised as C and D, which are the buildings that are in the worst conditions according to what we currently hold in terms of data. I think, more broadly, a focus on this to ensure that our school buildings really are appropriate for our learners and the opportunities we want to give them is what sits behind making that priority a manifesto commitment.
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated: Diolch. Dim ond gwybodaeth lefel uchel iawn ar gyflwr ysgolion y mae Llywodraeth Cymru'n ei chadw, felly rwy'n credu bod hwn yn fater y bydd angen mynd ar ei drywydd gyda'r awdurdod lleol. Ond fe ddywedaf ein bod wedi ymrwymo i gynnal yr arolwg o adeiladau ysgolion, a bod y gwaith yn parhau nawr, i gydnabod y ffaith ein bod yn gwybod bod problem sylweddol ledled Cymru gydag adeiladau ysgolion. Rydym yn mynd i flaenoriaethu'r rhai yng nghategori C a D, sef yr adeiladau sydd yn y cyflwr gwaethaf yn ôl y data sydd gennym ar hyn o bryd. Yn fwy cyffredinol, ffocws ar hyn i sicrhau bod ein hadeiladau ysgol yn briodol i'n dysgwyr a'r cyfleoedd rydym am eu rhoi iddynt yw'r rheswm dros wneud y flaenoriaeth honno'n ymrwymiad maniffesto.

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_welsh: 2. Cwestiynau i'r Gweinidog Cabinet dros Addysg a’r Gymraeg
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 2. Questions to the Cabinet Minister for Education and Welsh Language
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim: Diolch. A'r cwestiwn olaf i chi, Weinidog, cwestiwn 8—Francesca O'Brien.
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated: Thank you. And the final question to you, Minister, question 8—Francesca O'Brien.

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_welsh: 2. Cwestiynau i'r Gweinidog Cabinet dros Addysg a’r Gymraeg

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated: Funding for Education

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_welsh: 2. Cwestiynau i'r Gweinidog Cabinet dros Addysg a’r Gymraeg
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 2. Questions to the Cabinet Minister for Education and Welsh Language

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated: 8. How is the Welsh Government working with local councils to ensure adequate funding for education? OQ64517

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_welsh: 2. Cwestiynau i'r Gweinidog Cabinet dros Addysg a’r Gymraeg
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 2. Questions to the Cabinet Minister for Education and Welsh Language
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim: We recognise that schools and local authorities continue to face a range of financial pressures. I am committed to listening to, engaging with and working collaboratively with local authorities to ensure our decisions make a real difference for learners.
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated: Rydym yn cydnabod bod ysgolion ac awdurdodau lleol yn parhau i wynebu ystod o fathau o bwysau ariannol. Rwy'n ymrwymedig i wrando ar awdurdodau lleol, i ymgysylltu a gweithio ar y cyd â nhw i sicrhau bod ein penderfyniadau yn gwneud gwahaniaeth go iawn i ddysgwyr.

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_welsh: 2. Cwestiynau i'r Gweinidog Cabinet dros Addysg a’r Gymraeg
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 2. Questions to the Cabinet Minister for Education and Welsh Language
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim:
Diolch, Minister, for your answer. Just three months into this financial year, Swansea Council has already overspent by £13.7 million over its budget. It has imposed a vacancy freeze and severe spending restrictions. The council's finance director warns that its general reserves are already below, and I quote, 'the absolute minimum of acceptability', end of quote, and the council is now considering using its reserves. Of course, once these reserves are spent, they are gone, and its schools buildings programme is £73 million more than it can afford, so fewer schools will get the investment that they were promised.

One of the fastest growing pressures on councils is additional learning needs. Wales received additional funding for ALN on the back of increased spending in England, but your supplementary budget kept that money in Cardiff Bay, rather than sending it to councils and schools that actually support these children. So, when you bring your revised plans forward this autumn, Minister, will you commit to passing that ALN funding directly to local authorities so councils aren't forced to drain their reserves to fill that spending gap?
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated:
Diolch am eich ateb, Weinidog. Dri mis yn unig i mewn i'r flwyddyn ariannol hon, mae Cyngor Abertawe eisoes wedi gorwario £13.7 miliwn dros ei gyllideb. Mae wedi rhewi swyddi gwag ac wedi gorfodi cyfyngiadau gwariant difrifol. Mae cyfarwyddwr cyllid y cyngor yn rhybuddio bod ei gronfeydd wrth gefn cyffredinol eisoes yn is na'r isafswm absoliwt o'r hyn sy'n dderbyniol, ac mae'r cyngor bellach yn ystyried defnyddio ei gronfeydd wrth gefn. Wrth gwrs, pan gaiff y cronfeydd wrth gefn hyn eu gwario, byddant wedi mynd, ac mae eu rhaglen adeiladau ysgolion £73 miliwn yn fwy nag y gall ei fforddio, felly bydd llai o ysgolion yn cael y buddsoddiad a addawyd iddynt.

Un o'r pethau sy'n achosi'r pwysau sy'n tyfu gyflymaf ar gynghorau yw anghenion dysgu ychwanegol. Derbyniodd Cymru arian ychwanegol ar gyfer ADY yn sgil cynnydd mewn gwariant yn Lloegr, ond cadwodd eich cyllideb atodol yr arian hwnnw ym Mae Caerdydd, yn hytrach na'i anfon at y cynghorau a'r ysgolion sy'n cefnogi'r plant hyn mewn gwirionedd. Felly, pan fyddwch chi'n cyflwyno eich cynlluniau diwygiedig yr hydref hwn, Weinidog, a wnewch chi ymrwymo i drosglwyddo'r cyllid ADY hwnnw yn uniongyrchol i awdurdodau lleol fel nad yw cynghorau yn cael eu gorfodi i ddihysbyddu eu cronfeydd wrth gefn er mwyn llenwi'r bwlch yn y gwariant?

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_welsh: 2. Cwestiynau i'r Gweinidog Cabinet dros Addysg a’r Gymraeg
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 2. Questions to the Cabinet Minister for Education and Welsh Language
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim: Thank you very much. These are conversations that are ongoing with local authorities. I met, in fact, with the Welsh Local Government Association yesterday to discuss a range of factors that are impacting local authorities at the moment. To return to the ALN spending, I agree with you that this is a pressing priority for local authorities and for our schools, which is why we made those commitments around funding in the supplementary budget. She will be aware that that was not successful, but that is continuing work and there remain opportunities for that funding to be sent to local authorities and schools to address some of these issues.
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated: Diolch yn fawr iawn. Mae'r rhain yn sgyrsiau sydd ar y gweill gydag awdurdodau lleol. Fe wneuthum gyfarfod â Chymdeithas Llywodraeth Leol Cymru ddoe mewn gwirionedd i drafod ystod o ffactorau sy'n effeithio ar awdurdodau lleol ar hyn o bryd. I ddychwelyd at wariant ADY, rwy'n cytuno â chi fod hynny'n flaenoriaeth ddybryd i awdurdodau lleol ac i'n hysgolion, a dyna pam y gwnaethom yr ymrwymiadau ynghylch cyllid yn y gyllideb atodol. Fe fydd hi'n ymwybodol nad oedd hynny'n llwyddiannus, ond mae hwnnw'n waith parhaus ac mae cyfleoedd o hyd i'r cyllid hwnnw gael ei anfon at awdurdodau lleol ac ysgolion i fynd i'r afael â rhai o'r problemau hyn.

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_welsh: 3. Cwestiynau i Gomisiwn y Senedd
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 3. Questions to the Senedd Commission
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim: The Senedd Commission is committed to ensuring that we are inclusive to everyone who works on or visits the estate. We have facilities available for those who need to express milk following the birth of their child. The quiet rooms can be used for expressing milk, and fridges are available to store the milk. These can be found on the ground floor in Tŷ Hywel in B block, opposite the committee rooms, and one in the Senedd on the Neuadd level. In addition, people can access the first aid rooms, where privacy, seating or couch facilities are provided. All these facilities are lockable and can be marked as occupied. For Commission staff, managers and HR support return-to-work planning after maternity leave in a number of ways, including a new and expectant parent risk assessment, covering practical arrangements such as quiet rooms, hygiene facilities and secure refrigerated storage.
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated: Mae Comisiwn y Senedd wedi ymrwymo i sicrhau ein bod yn gynhwysol i bawb sy'n gweithio ar yr ystad neu'n ymweld â'r ystad. Mae gennym gyfleusterau ar gael i'r rhai sydd angen tynnu llaeth ar ôl genedigaeth eu plentyn. Gellir defnyddio'r ystafelloedd tawel ar gyfer tynnu llaeth, ac mae oergelloedd ar gael i storio'r llaeth. Mae'r rhain i'w gweld ar y llawr gwaelod yn Nhŷ Hywel ym mloc B, gyferbyn â'r ystafelloedd pwyllgor, ac un yn y Senedd ar lefel y Neuadd. Yn ogystal, gall pobl gael mynediad i'r ystafelloedd cymorth cyntaf, lle darperir preifatrwydd, cadeiriau neu gyfleusterau soffa. Mae modd cloi'r holl gyfleusterau hyn a nodi eu bod mewn defnydd. Ar gyfer staff y Comisiwn, mae rheolwyr a'r adran adnoddau dynol yn cefnogi cynlluniau dychwelyd i'r gwaith ar ôl absenoldeb mamolaeth mewn sawl ffordd, gan gynnwys asesiad risg rhieni newydd a darpar rieni, sy'n cwmpasu trefniadau ymarferol fel ystafelloedd tawel, cyfleusterau hylendid a darpariaethau storio diogel mewn oergelloedd.

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_welsh: 3. Cwestiynau i Gomisiwn y Senedd
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 3. Questions to the Senedd Commission
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim: Thank you for that. I just wanted to flag some of my lived experience, because as a mother of a young baby, I had the experience of trying to find a suitable place to pump on the Senedd estate. I was initially offered the medical room you mentioned, but it only had a bed in it, and you can't pump lying down, and I do need a desk and chair to work, and I couldn't possibly lose two hours of my working day. I was then offered the quiet room, but if you look on the internal intranet, this room is listed as a place for prayer and contemplation, so that wasn't appropriate. I then had to use a printing room, which had no lock on the door, until I got in touch with the Senedd estate, and it also had no access then to the fridge that was in the medical room. So, given that the Senedd aims to be family friendly and inclusive, I was surprised that these facilities don't seem to support pumping on the estate, and the NHS does recommend breastfeeding up until two years, when most parents will have returned to work. Only 32 per cent of babies are still being breastfed at six months, despite all of the known benefits. So, I was wondering if you would look at creating a space for pumping that enables people to work at the same time, and confirm to me that no member of staff or Member will face the same circumstances I was in.
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated: Diolch am hynny. Roeddwn i eisiau nodi peth o fy mhrofiad personol, oherwydd fel mam i fabi ifanc, cefais y profiad o geisio dod o hyd i le addas i bwmpio ar ystad y Senedd. I ddechrau, cynigiwyd yr ystafell feddygol a grybwylloch chi, ond dim ond gwely oedd ynddi, ac ni allwch bwmpio wrth orwedd, ac mae angen desg a chadair arnaf i weithio, ac ni allwn golli dwy awr o'm diwrnod gwaith. Wedyn cynigiwyd yr ystafell dawel, ond os edrychwch ar y fewnrwyd fewnol, mae'r ystafell hon wedi'i rhestru fel lle i weddïo a myfyrio, felly nid oedd honno'n briodol. Yna roedd yn rhaid imi ddefnyddio ystafell argraffu, heb glo ar y drws, nes imi gysylltu ag ystad y Senedd, ac nid oedd mynediad i'r oergell a oedd yn yr ystafell feddygol. Felly, o ystyried mai nod y Senedd yw bod yn gynhwysol ac ystyriol o deuluoedd, roeddwn i'n synnu nad yw'r cyfleusterau hyn yn cefnogi pwmpio ar yr ystad, ac mae'r GIG yn argymell bwydo ar y fron nes y bydd plentyn yn ddwyflwydd oed, pan fydd y rhan fwyaf o rieni wedi dychwelyd i'r gwaith. Dim ond 32 y cant o fabanod sy'n dal i gael eu bwydo ar y fron ar ôl chwe mis, er gwaethaf yr holl fanteision y gwyddys amdanynt. Felly, roeddwn i'n meddwl tybed a wnewch chi edrych ar greu gofod ar gyfer pwmpio sy'n galluogi pobl i weithio ar yr un pryd, a chadarnhau wrthyf na fydd unrhyw aelod o staff nac Aelod yn wynebu'r un amgylchiadau ag a wynebais i.

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_welsh: 3. Cwestiynau i Gomisiwn y Senedd
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 3. Questions to the Senedd Commission
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim: I really welcome that feedback from your own experience, and thank you for sharing that with us. I'm more than happy to take that back to officials and to facilitate, if necessary, discussion with my officials so that they can look at that. One of the opportunities as to what we can do now to improve that—and we do want to be, very much, that best practice in terms of the workplace—the other thing going forward is how we respond to the family friendly and inclusive parliament review, which had recommendations specifically with regard to family friendly support, breastfeeding and so on. So, if you're happy, I'll facilitate those discussions and we can look at how we can improve it now.
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated: Rwy'n croesawu'r adborth o'ch profiad chi, a diolch ichi am rannu hynny gyda ni. Rwy'n fwy na hapus i fynd â hynny yn ôl at swyddogion ac i hwyluso trafodaeth gyda fy swyddogion, os oes angen, fel y gallant edrych ar hynny. Un o'r cyfleoedd o ran yr hyn y gallwn ei wneud nawr i wella hynny—ac rydym yn awyddus iawn i sicrhau arfer gorau yn y gweithle—y peth arall yn y dyfodol yw sut i ymateb i'r adolygiad o senedd gynhwysol sy'n ystyriol o deuluoedd, a oedd yn cynnwys argymhellion penodol mewn perthynas â chefnogaeth ystyriol o deuluoedd, bwydo ar y fron ac yn y blaen. Felly, os ydych chi'n hapus, fe wnaf hwyluso'r trafodaethau hynny a gallwn edrych ar sut y gallwn ei wella nawr.

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated: Questions 2 and 7 are grouped. Question 2 first—Joe Martin.

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_welsh: 3. Cwestiynau i Gomisiwn y Senedd
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 3. Questions to the Senedd Commission
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim: Diolch, Joe. Bay 32 is the Commission’s project to secure fit-for-purpose accommodation beyond the expiry of the Tŷ Hywel lease, which happens in 2032. A competitive procurement concluded that the best value option is a major refurbishment and renewal of Tŷ Hywel, with the potential for Commission ownership. Equitix is the preferred bidder and its proposal includes more than £50 million of landlord investment—landlord investment—in the building. This is planned to include increasing the amount of useable space in Tŷ Hywel by 25 per cent. The project is now in detailed design during a pre-development phase with capped costs to the Commission. Because the building must remain operational during major works, temporary accommodation will be needed for Members, staff and for services. So, the Commission will consider options for managing any relocation, before considering the full business case later this year. The works are currently expected to begin from early summer 2027 and last for up to three years.
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated: Diolch, Joe. Bae 32 yw prosiect y Comisiwn i sicrhau adeilad addas i'r diben wedi i  brydles Tŷ Hywel ddod i ben, sy'n digwydd yn 2032. Daeth proses caffael cystadleuol i'r casgliad mai'r opsiwn gwerth gorau yw gwaith adnewyddu ac ailwampio ar Dŷ Hywel, gyda'r potensial i'r Comisiwn ei berchnogi. Equitix yw'r cynigydd a ffafrir ac mae eu cynnig yn cynnwys mwy na £50 miliwn o fuddsoddiad landlord yn yr adeilad. Bwriedir i hyn gynnwys cynnydd o 25 y cant yn y gofod y gellir ei ddefnyddio yn Nhŷ Hywel. Mae'r prosiect bellach yn cael ei gynllunio'n fanwl yn ystod y cyfnod cyn-ddatblygu gyda chostau wedi'u capio i'r Comisiwn. Am fod yn rhaid i'r adeilad barhau i fod yn weithredol wrth i waith adeiladu gael ei wneud, bydd angen adeilad dros dro ar gyfer Aelodau, staff ac ar gyfer gwasanaethau. Felly, bydd y Comisiwn yn ystyried opsiynau ar gyfer rheoli unrhyw adleoli, cyn ystyried yr achos busnes llawn yn ddiweddarach eleni. Ar hyn o bryd disgwylir i'r gwaith ddechrau yn gynnar yn haf 2027 a pharhau am hyd at dair blynedd.

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_welsh: 3. Cwestiynau i Gomisiwn y Senedd
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 3. Questions to the Senedd Commission
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim: Thank you, Commissioner. Rent on Tŷ Hywel currently costs £2.7 million per year. Can you give any indication of what that might rise to once the proposed construction is complete?
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated: Diolch, Gomisiynydd. Ar hyn o bryd mae rhent Tŷ Hywel yn costio £2.7 miliwn y flwyddyn. A allwch chi roi unrhyw arwydd o beth y gallai hynny godi iddo pan fydd y gwaith adeiladu arfaethedig wedi'i gwblhau?

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_welsh: 3. Cwestiynau i Gomisiwn y Senedd
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 3. Questions to the Senedd Commission
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim: I'm pleased to reiterate what I said in my opening remarks. First of all, the project is now in a capped cost pre-development phase. It's pegged. There's a clear understanding and expectation from all of the Commissioners who were involved in taking this forward, and an understanding from the potential project delivery partners as well. The other thing, reiterating but expanding a little bit on what I said earlier, is that we ran a competitive process. So, the Commission had a real choice of options of how to do this very important work for all of us and the constituents who come here to meet us as well. So, we tested the markets and secured what we believe is a very strong proposal for the long-term future of Tŷ Hywel. But one other thing I would say to you, Joe, and to other Members, is that we're keen that the project continues to be shaped by Member feedback, in providing those spaces that allow you and others to carry out your parliamentary roles. So, no decision has been taken yet to proceed, of course, with construction; the full business case is yet to be brought forward. We look forward to engaging with Members, and also with political groups as well, on the proposals as they're developed.
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated: Rwy'n falch o ailadrodd yr hyn a ddywedais yn fy sylwadau agoriadol. Yn gyntaf oll, mae'r prosiect bellach mewn cyfnod cyn-ddatblygu gyda chostau wedi'u capio. Mae wedi'i sefydlu. Mae dealltwriaeth a disgwyliad clir gan yr holl Gomisiynwyr a oedd yn ymwneud â bwrw hyn yn ei flaen, a dealltwriaeth gan y partneriaid cyflawni prosiect posibl hefyd. Y peth arall, i ailadrodd ond ehangu ychydig ar yr hyn a ddywedais yn gynharach, yw ein bod wedi cynnal proses gystadleuol. Felly, roedd gan y Comisiwn ddewis go iawn o opsiynau ynghylch sut i wneud y gwaith pwysig hwn i bob un ohonom a'r etholwyr sy'n dod yma i gyfarfod â ni hefyd. Felly, fe wnaethom brofi'r marchnadoedd a sicrhau yr hyn y credwn ei fod yn gynnig cryf iawn ar gyfer dyfodol hirdymor Tŷ Hywel. Ond un peth arall yr hoffwn ei ddweud wrthych chi, Joe, ac wrth Aelodau eraill, yw ein bod yn awyddus i'r prosiect barhau i gael ei siapio gan adborth yr Aelodau, i ddarparu'r mannau sy'n caniatáu i chi ac eraill gyflawni eich rolau seneddol. Felly, nid oes unrhyw benderfyniad wedi'i wneud eto i fwrw ymlaen gyda'r adeiladu wrth gwrs; mae'r achos busnes llawn eto i'w gyflwyno. Edrychwn ymlaen at ymgysylltu ag Aelodau, a chyda'r grwpiau gwleidyddol yn ogystal, ar y cynigion wrth iddynt gael eu datblygu.

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_welsh: 3. Cwestiynau i Gomisiwn y Senedd
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 3. Questions to the Senedd Commission

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_welsh: 3. Cwestiynau i Gomisiwn y Senedd
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 3. Questions to the Senedd Commission
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim: Thank you, you've answered a couple of questions in your statement, so I just wanted to ask: will the landlord be paying for the costs relating to moving us and staff members, or is it just for the improvements to Tŷ Hywel? Thanks.
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated: Diolch, rydych chi wedi ateb un neu ddau o gwestiynau yn eich datganiad, felly roeddwn i eisiau gofyn: a fydd y landlord yn talu am y costau sy'n gysylltiedig â'n symud ni ac aelodau staff, neu ai dim ond ar gyfer y gwelliannau i Dŷ Hywel? Diolch.

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_welsh: 3. Cwestiynau i Gomisiwn y Senedd
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 3. Questions to the Senedd Commission
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim:
So, the cost of what is known as the 'decant strategy', and the different options on that that Commissioners are currently considering, is within the cost we've already described. So, we're not looking at an escalating cost; we're looking at managing it within the budgets we've already put for it. And, as I say, this pre-development phase, we've got capped costs for this. So, I hope that's an assurance to the Member. And, I have to say, there's very robust challenge from the Commissioners, all of them, in terms of keeping this within the cost envelope that we've anticipated.

Ideally, going forward, we'll have a good building that is refurbished and fit for now and for years to come, that enhances the experience for Members and for people who visit here, and we can also do that in a very cost-effective way. Because at the moment—Members shouldn't be under any misapprehension as to what we are facing—if we don't proceed with this, the status quo option includes forking out for repairs to the existing building, into the millions of pounds. So, what we're trying to do is avoid that eventuality.
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated:
Mae cost yr hyn a elwir yn 'strategaeth adleoli', a'r gwahanol opsiynau ar hynny y mae Comisiynwyr yn eu hystyried ar hyn o bryd, o fewn y gost rydym eisoes wedi'i disgrifio. Felly, nid ydym yn edrych ar gost cynyddol; rydym yn edrych ar ei reoli o fewn y cyllidebau rydym eisoes wedi'u rhoi ar ei gyfer. Ac fel y dywedaf, mae gennym gostau wedi'u capio ar gyfer y cam cyn-ddatblygu. Felly, rwy'n gobeithio bod hynny'n rhoi sicrwydd i'r Aelod. Ac mae'n rhaid imi ddweud, mae yna her gadarn iawn gan y Comisiynwyr, bob un ohonynt, i gadw hyn o fewn yr amlen gostau a ragwelwyd gennym.

Yn ddelfrydol, yn y dyfodol, bydd gennym adeilad da wedi'i adnewyddu sy'n addas ar gyfer nawr ac am flynyddoedd i ddod, gan wella'r profiad i Aelodau ac i bobl sy'n ymweld â'r lle hwn, a gallwn wneud hynny mewn ffordd gosteffeithiol iawn hefyd. Oherwydd ar hyn o bryd—ni ddylai Aelodau gamddeall yr hyn a wynebwn—os na fwriwn ymlaen â hyn, mae'r opsiwn status quo yn cynnwys talu am atgyweiriadau i'r adeilad presennol, a fydd yn filiynau o bunnoedd. Felly, yr hyn a wnawn yw ceisio osgoi hynny.

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_welsh: 3. Cwestiynau i Gomisiwn y Senedd
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 3. Questions to the Senedd Commission
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim: Cynllun Pensiwn y Gwasanaeth Sifil
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated: Civil Service Pension Scheme

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_welsh: 3. Cwestiynau i Gomisiwn y Senedd
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 3. Questions to the Senedd Commission
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim: 3. Pa asesiad y mae'r Comisiwn wedi'i wneud o effaith yr ôl-groniad parhaus o daliadau o Gynllun Pensiwn y Gwasanaeth Sifil ar ei gyflogeion presennol a chyn-gyflogeion? OQ64546
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated: 3. What assessment has the Commission made of the impact of the ongoing backlog of payments from the Civil Service Pension Scheme on its current and former employees? OQ64546

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_welsh: 3. Cwestiynau i Gomisiwn y Senedd
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 3. Questions to the Senedd Commission
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim:
Diolch, Lindsay. Responsibility for administering the civil service pension scheme transferred from MyCSP to Capita on 1 December 2025. The change was intended to modernise the service, but the transfer included a substantial volume of cases affecting some retirement quotations and new pension payments. The Cabinet Office and Capita established a recovery programme to prioritise urgent and hardship cases, clear outstanding work, and restore contracted service standards.

The Commission currently has fewer than five former employees who have retired since Capita became the administrators, one of which has accessed the hardship loan scheme introduced by the Commission, in line with Cabinet Office guidance, to mitigate the financial impact, and we continue to monitor the situation and seek assurances that outstanding cases are resolved very quickly.
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated:
Diolch, Lindsay. Trosglwyddwyd y cyfrifoldeb am weinyddu cynllun pensiwn y gwasanaeth sifil o MyCSP i Capita ar 1 Rhagfyr 2025. Bwriad y newid oedd moderneiddio'r gwasanaeth, ond roedd y trosglwyddiad yn cynnwys nifer sylweddol o achosion sy'n effeithio ar rai dyfynbrisiau ymddeol a thaliadau pensiwn newydd. Sefydlodd Swyddfa'r Cabinet a Capita raglen adfer i flaenoriaethu achosion brys a chaledi, clirio gwaith heb ei gyflawni, ac adfer safonau gwasanaethau dan gontract.

Ar hyn o bryd mae gan y Comisiwn lai na phum cyn-weithiwr wedi ymddeol ers i Capita ddod yn weinyddwyr, ac mae un ohonynt wedi defnyddio'r cynllun benthyciadau caledi a gyflwynwyd gan y Comisiwn, yn unol â chanllawiau Swyddfa'r Cabinet, i liniaru'r effaith ariannol, ac rydym yn parhau i fonitro'r sefyllfa a cheisio sicrwydd fod achosion heb eu datrys yn cael eu datrys yn gyflym iawn.

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_welsh: 3. Cwestiynau i Gomisiwn y Senedd
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 3. Questions to the Senedd Commission
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim: Thank you, Commissioner. I have been contacted by three constituents—probably three of the five—regarding the unacceptable and worrying delays and backlogs they're dealing with from Capita, the managing company of the civil service pension scheme. Capita has issued a statement saying that they have everything in place to begin clearing the backlog. However, they will not provide a timeline for when every case will be cleared, nor will they provide a date for my constituents on their individual cases, and that is important. I've met people who have worked all their lives in the service of the public, and they now face serious financial hardship. They shouldn't have to go for financial loans at that time of life because their public pensions, of course, were outsourced to a private company unable, let's be honest, to manage those pensions. Has the Commission had any discussions with the Cabinet Office in Westminster or the civil service pension scheme regarding the retired former employees from the Senedd? And if not, can you please commit to doing this?
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated: Diolch, Gomisiynydd. Cysylltodd tri etholwr â mi—tri o'r pump mae'n debyg—ynghylch yr oedi a'r ôl-groniadau annerbyniol a phryderus a wynebant gan Capita, y cwmni sy'n rheoli cynllun pensiwn y gwasanaeth sifil. Mae Capita wedi cyhoeddi datganiad yn dweud bod ganddynt bopeth yn ei le i ddechrau clirio'r ôl-groniad. Fodd bynnag, ni wnânt ddarparu amserlen ar gyfer pryd y caiff pob achos ei ddatrys, ac ni wnânt roi dyddiad i fy etholwyr ynglŷn â'u hachosion unigol chwaith, ac mae hynny'n bwysig. Rwyf wedi cyfarfod â phobl sydd wedi gweithio'n gwasanaethu'r cyhoedd ar hyd eu hoes, ac maent bellach yn wynebu caledi ariannol difrifol. Ni ddylai fod angen iddynt geisio am fenthyciadau ariannol ar y cam hwn yn eu bywydau am fod eu pensiynau cyhoeddus wedi cael eu rhoi allan i gwmni preifat nad yw'n gallu rheoli'r pensiynau hynny, gadewch inni fod yn onest. A yw'r Comisiwn wedi cael unrhyw drafodaethau gyda Swyddfa'r Cabinet yn San Steffan neu gynllun pensiwn y gwasanaeth sifil ynghylch y cyn-weithwyr Senedd hyn sydd wedi ymddeol? Ac os na, a allwch chi ymrwymo i wneud hynny?

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_welsh: 3. Cwestiynau i Gomisiwn y Senedd
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 3. Questions to the Senedd Commission
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim: Diolch yn fawr am godi y mater yma.
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated: Thank you very much for raising this issue.

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_welsh: 3. Cwestiynau i Gomisiwn y Senedd
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 3. Questions to the Senedd Commission
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim:
It raises serious issues and, I agree, the situation is completely unacceptable. The welfare of former employees is paramount to what this Commission is looking to do.

In answer to your question, the chief executive has written to the managing director of Capita Pensions Solutions earlier this year to raise the concerns that you've raised, and former members of staff have raised, about the impact the backlog was having on Commission staff. To date, we haven't had a response to that, and that is also unacceptable.

But, in turning to what the Commission has done to support your constituents and others, in addition to administering the hardship loan, the human resources service continues to provide ongoing communication to affected retired staff, and the welfare of former employees has remained our primary concern. So, we will be keeping that under review and, where possible, furthering it as well.
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated:
Mae'n codi materion difrifol ac rwy'n cytuno, mae'r sefyllfa'n gwbl annerbyniol. Mae lles cyn-weithwyr yn hollbwysig i'r hyn y mae'r Comisiwn hwn yn ceisio ei wneud.

Mewn ymateb i'ch cwestiwn, mae'r prif weithredwr wedi ysgrifennu at reolwr gyfarwyddwr Capita Pensions Solutions yn gynharach eleni i godi'r pryderon a godwyd gennych chi, a chyn-aelodau o staff, am effaith yr ôl-groniad ar staff y Comisiwn. Hyd yma, nid ydym wedi cael ymateb, ac mae hynny hefyd yn annerbyniol.

Ond wrth droi at yr hyn y mae'r Comisiwn wedi'i wneud i gefnogi eich etholwyr ac eraill, yn ogystal â gweinyddu'r benthyciadau caledi, mae'r gwasanaeth adnoddau dynol yn parhau i ddarparu cyfathrebiadau parhaus i staff sydd wedi ymddeol yr effeithir arnynt, ac mae lles cyn-weithwyr wedi parhau i fod o'r pwys mwyaf i ni. Felly, byddwn yn cadw hynny dan arolwg, a lle bo'n bosibl, yn mynd ag ef ymhellach hefyd.

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated: Welfare of Members and their Staff

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_welsh: 3. Cwestiynau i Gomisiwn y Senedd
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 3. Questions to the Senedd Commission
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim: I thought my name was Tom, then. Diolch, Presiding Officer.
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated: Roeddwn i'n meddwl mai Tom oedd fy enw i am eiliad. Diolch, Lywydd.

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_welsh: 3. Cwestiynau i Gomisiwn y Senedd
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 3. Questions to the Senedd Commission
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim: 5. Pa gamau y mae'r Comisiwn yn eu cymryd i ddiogelu lles Aelodau a'u staff? OQ64516
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated: 5. What action is the Commission taking to safeguard the welfare of Members and their staff? OQ64516

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_welsh: 3. Cwestiynau i Gomisiwn y Senedd
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 3. Questions to the Senedd Commission
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim:
Diolch, Francesca. The Commission takes the welfare of Members and their staff very seriously, and we provide practical, accessible support across well-being, employment, health and safety, dignity and respect, safeguarding, and, of course, security. This includes confidential employee assistance and occupational health services, tailored HR guidance and training, and security advice and measures. The Hwb brings information and face-to-face support together in one place, with a weekly virtual drop-in for support staff, whatever their location.

The Commission's phased learning framework treats personal resilience, well-being and maintaining a healthy work-life balance as continuing development needs rather than one-off induction topics. Training is repeated, reinforced and extended through the Senedd term, with provision adapted to Member and support staff learning needs and delivery preferences. 

And just finally, the Members' security team provides support to Members on a wide range of personal safety and security matters, including advice and guidance, the implementation of security measures at homes and offices, practical support and advice relating to social media security, and the reporting and management of security-related incidents.
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated:
Diolch, Francesca. Mae'r Comisiwn yn ystyried bod lles Aelodau a'u staff yn bwysig iawn, ac rydym yn darparu cymorth ymarferol a hygyrch o ran llesiant, cyflogaeth, iechyd a diogelwch, urddas a pharch, diogelu, a diogelwch wrth gwrs. Mae hyn yn cynnwys cymorth cyfrinachol i weithwyr a gwasanaethau iechyd galwedigaethol, canllawiau a hyfforddiant adnoddau dynol wedi'u teilwra, a chyngor a mesurau diogelwch. Mae'r Hwb yn dod â gwybodaeth a chefnogaeth wyneb yn wyneb at ei gilydd mewn un lle, gyda darpariaeth galw heibio rhithwir wythnosol i staff cymorth, ble bynnag y bônt.

Mae fframwaith dysgu'r Comisiwn yn trin gwydnwch personol, llesiant a chynnal cydbwysedd iach rhwng gwaith a bywyd fel anghenion datblygu parhaus yn hytrach na phynciau sefydlu untro. Mae'r hyfforddiant yn cael ei ailadrodd, ei atgyfnerthu a'i ymestyn trwy dymor y Senedd, gyda darpariaeth wedi'i addasu i anghenion dysgu a dewisiadau cyflawni Aelodau a staff cymorth.

Ac yn olaf, mae tîm diogelwch yr Aelodau yn darparu cefnogaeth i'r Aelodau ar ystod eang o faterion diogelwch personol, gan gynnwys cyngor ac arweiniad, gweithredu mesurau diogelwch mewn cartrefi a swyddfeydd, cymorth a chyngor ymarferol sy'n ymwneud â diogelwch cyfryngau cymdeithasol, a rheoli ac adrodd am ddigwyddiadau sy'n gysylltiedig â diogelwch.

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_welsh: 3. Cwestiynau i Gomisiwn y Senedd
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 3. Questions to the Senedd Commission
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim: Diolch for the description there. If I can provide some context to my question, and the scene I want to picture: Members of this Chamber and their support staff come into the Tŷ Hywel building each day to carry out their work freely, often in areas where members of the public are excluded unless they're chaperoned around the building. However, what's become quite clear is that we do have journalists, dare I say, lurking along the corridors in areas that we don't know. Some could be on the radio. We don't know who they are, or what they look like. I can give an example of that, if I may: just before the summer recess, going into the ladies' bathroom on level 2 and meeting a very chatty lady as I came out of the cubicle—and I know we all like a good chat, and I'm one for those—however, she asked for my number, when I believed perhaps she was support staff for one of my colleagues, and it was actually a journalist. So, I do think there are lines being blurred here between the access that they have to our workspace and kind of being led down a garden path, shall I say? I don't think that's appropriate, and I do wonder whether we can consider that they are put in a certain restricted area and not have free access to where we work, including the bathrooms as well.
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated: Diolch am y disgrifiad. Os caf roi rhywfaint o gyd-destun i fy nghwestiwn, a'r olygfa rwyf eisiau ei darlunio: mae Aelodau'r Siambr hon a'u staff cymorth yn dod i mewn i adeilad Tŷ Hywel bob dydd i wneud eu gwaith yn rhydd, yn aml mewn mannau lle mae aelodau o'r cyhoedd wedi'u gwahardd oni bai eu bod yn cael eu tywys o gwmpas yr adeilad. Fodd bynnag, yr hyn sydd wedi dod yn eithaf amlwg yw bod gennym newyddiadurwyr, meiddiaf ddweud, yn llechu ar hyd y coridorau mewn mannau nas gwyddom amdanynt. Gallai rhai fod ar y radio. Nid ydym yn gwybod pwy ydynt, na sut y maent yn edrych. Gallaf roi enghraifft o hynny, os caf: ychydig cyn toriad yr haf, wrth fynd i ystafell ymolchi y menywod ar lefel 2 a chyfarfod â menyw barod iawn ei sgwrs wrth imi ddod allan o'r ciwbicl—ac rwy'n gwybod ein bod ni i gyd yn hoffi sgwrs dda, ac rwy'n un am y rheini—ond gofynnodd am fy rhif, a minnau'n meddwl efallai ei bod hi'n aelod o staff cymorth un o fy nghyd-Aelodau, ond newyddiadurwr oedd hi mewn gwirionedd. Felly, rwy'n credu bod yna linellau aneglur yma rhwng y mynediad sydd ganddynt i'n gweithle a rhyw fath o gael ein twyllo, dylwn ddweud? Nid wyf yn credu bod hynny'n briodol, ac rwy'n meddwl tybed a gawn ni ystyried eu bod yn cael eu rhoi mewn ardal gyfyngedig benodol heb fynediad rhydd i'r mannau lle rydym yn gweithio, gan gynnwys yr ystafelloedd ymolchi.

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_welsh: 3. Cwestiynau i Gomisiwn y Senedd
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 3. Questions to the Senedd Commission
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim:
Thank you for that. It's helpful with that supplementary. The Commissioners, of course, keep constantly under review the access and the privileged access to different parts of not just the Senedd building, but also here within Tŷ Hywel as well. There are different levels of pass holders, and there's an expectation as well that there's an accompaniment of visitors into certain areas by pass holders—just to remind colleagues as well. But we do keep this under review, and we do keep a refresh on it. So, I take on board the individual example that you're saying. Perhaps we can discuss it further in terms of what area that was, what precise location that was.

But we do also want the building to be able to be accessible to people who want to ask us questions as elected representatives and for constituency members who visit us, and for legitimate lobbyists who come here from health organisations, et cetera, et cetera. So, point taken. I'm happy to discuss the individual location that you mentioned and, of course, Commissioners will always keep this under review.
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated:
Diolch am hynny. Mae'n ddefnyddiol gyda'r cwestiwn atodol hwnnw. Mae'r Comisiynwyr, wrth gwrs, yn adolygu mynediad a mynediad breintiedig i wahanol rannau'n barhaus, nid yn unig i adeilad y Senedd, ond hefyd yma yn Nhŷ Hywel. Mae yna wahanol lefelau o ddeiliaid pasys, ac mae disgwyliad hefyd y dylai deiliaid pasys hebrwng ymwelwyr i fannau penodol—os caf atgoffa'r cyd-Aelodau. Ond rydym yn cadw hyn dan arolwg, ac rydym yn ei adnewyddu. Felly, rwy'n cymryd yr enghraifft unigol rydych chi'n ei nodi. Efallai y gallwn drafod ymhellach pa ardal oedd honno'n union.

Ond rydym hefyd eisiau i'r adeilad fod yn hygyrch i bobl sydd eisiau gofyn cwestiynau i ni fel cynrychiolwyr etholedig ac i aelodau etholaeth sy'n ymweld â ni, ac i lobïwyr dilys sy'n dod yma o sefydliadau iechyd, ac ati. Felly, mae'r pwynt wedi'i dderbyn. Rwy'n hapus i drafod y lleoliad unigol y sonioch chi amdano ac wrth gwrs, bydd y Comisiynwyr bob amser yn cadw hyn dan arolwg.

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_welsh: 3. Cwestiynau i Gomisiwn y Senedd
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 3. Questions to the Senedd Commission
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim: Diolch i'r Aelod am godi'r cwestiwn pwysig yma. Dwi'n gobeithio bod yr Aelod a hefyd pawb arall yn y Senedd yma'n cytuno â fi bod yn rhaid i ni hefyd fel Aelodau o'r Senedd gymryd cyfrifoldeb i edrych ar ôl ein gilydd, pa bynnag blaid. Mae hyn yn enwedig o bwysig pan mae'r byd ar-lein yn dod yn fwy treisgar tuag at wleidyddion, yn enwedig menywod ifanc. Felly, wrth i fi siarad am y byd ar-lein, hoffwn wybod beth mae'r Comisiwn yn ei wneud er mwyn cefnogi Aelodau o'r Senedd a staff sydd yn gweld eu lles yn cael ei effeithio'n negyddol oherwydd y cynnydd rydyn ni i gyd wedi gweld mewn cam-drin ar-lein, yn enwedig gydag AI hefyd, a deepfakes, jest fel enghraifft i ti.
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated: I thank the Member for raising this important point. I hope that the Member and also everyone else in this Senedd agrees with me that we also, as Members of the Senedd, must take responsibility for looking after each other, whatever our party. This is especially important when the online world is becoming ever more violent towards politicians, especially young women. Therefore, as I speak about the online world, I'd like to ask what the Commission is doing to support Members of the Senedd and staff who see their well-being being negatively impacted because of the increase that we have all seen in online abuse, especially with AI as well, and deepfakes, just as an example for you.

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_welsh: 3. Cwestiynau i Gomisiwn y Senedd
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 3. Questions to the Senedd Commission
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim: Diolch yn fawr iawn. I would refer Members very strongly not just to the Hwb, but to the security team presence as well, for all the advice and assistance they can give. Of course, there is an interaction that we have, not just as individual Members, but through our security people, including the observation and monitoring. It's not monitoring in a NASA style, but keeping an eye on what's happening online. There is engagement as well with police across Wales. This is an issue that affects all Members, because it can be quite a hostile environment out there. But I would strongly say to Members and their staff that if they have individual instances, they should bring them to the attention of our security people, because they want to hear about it and we need to be notified of it.
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated: Diolch yn fawr. Rwy'n cyfeirio'r Aelodau'n gryf iawn nid yn unig at yr Hwb, ond at bresenoldeb y tîm diogelwch hefyd, am yr holl gyngor a chymorth y gallant ei roi. Wrth gwrs, mae yna ryngweithio rhyngom, nid yn unig fel Aelodau unigol, ond drwy ein pobl ddiogelwch, gan gynnwys yr arsylwi a'r monitro. Nid yw'n fonitro ar lefel NASA, ond cadw llygad ar yr hyn sy'n digwydd ar-lein. Mae ymgysylltiad hefyd â'r heddlu ledled Cymru. Mae hwn yn fater sy'n effeithio ar bob Aelod, oherwydd gall fod yn amgylchedd eithaf gelyniaethus allan yno. Ond rwy'n dweud yn gryf wrth yr Aelodau a'u staff y dylent ddod ag unrhyw enghreifftiau unigol i sylw ein pobl ddiogelwch, gan eu bod eisiau clywed amdano ac mae angen inni wybod amdano.

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_welsh: 3. Cwestiynau i Gomisiwn y Senedd
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 3. Questions to the Senedd Commission
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim: 8. Pa wiriadau diogelu y mae'r Comisiwn yn gofyn i Aelodau o'r Senedd eu gwneud cyn iddynt ymgymryd â gweithgareddau sy'n ymwneud â phlant a phobl ifanc? OQ64547
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated: 8. What safeguarding checks does the Commission require of Members of the Senedd before they undertake activities involving children and young people? OQ64547

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_welsh: 3. Cwestiynau i Gomisiwn y Senedd
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 3. Questions to the Senedd Commission
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim: Diolch, Jane. Responsibility for safeguarding arrangements within Members' offices rests with the individual Members, as Members of the Senedd are individually elected and they're not Commission employees. Members need to have their own safeguarding policy appropriate to their role as office holders and employers, as they are responsible for their activities. The statutory disclosure and barring framework is reserved to the UK level.
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated: Diolch, Jane. Yr Aelodau unigol sy'n gyfrifol am drefniadau diogelu yn swyddfeydd yr Aelodau, gan fod Aelodau'r Senedd yn cael eu hethol yn unigol ac nid ydynt yn weithwyr cyflogedig i'r Comisiwn. Rhaid bod gan Aelodau eu polisi diogelu eu hunain sy'n briodol i'w rôl fel deiliaid swyddi a chyflogwyr, gan mai nhw sy'n gyfrifol am eu gweithgarwch. Mae'r fframwaith datgelu a gwahardd statudol yn fater a gedwir yn ôl ar lefel y DU.

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_welsh: 3. Cwestiynau i Gomisiwn y Senedd
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 3. Questions to the Senedd Commission
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim: Diolch yn fawr iawn am yr ymateb.
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated: Thank you very much for that response.

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_welsh: 3. Cwestiynau i Gomisiwn y Senedd
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 3. Questions to the Senedd Commission
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim: During my first term as a Senedd Member, I was really surprised that I could go into any school, any youth club, any provision where a child, a young person or a vulnerable person lived or worked without any checks, without any need to show any documentation. On all of those visits, I was accompanied by somebody, but it wouldn't take a genius and it wouldn't take much imagination for somebody quite powerful, who is a Member of the Senedd, to say, 'I'd like to do this on my own'. I do believe it is the Senedd's responsibility to ensure that Senedd Members, who have access and are in powerful roles to influence other people—. It should take the responsibility. There is no reference to this in any recent documentation, and I raised it in the last Senedd. I wonder if the Senedd Commission could take this forward, even on a voluntary basis, to look at how Members could get a DBS check, which doesn't give you an absolute safety mark, but it is a tool in the toolbox that ensures that this Parliament is not putting children, young people and vulnerable people at risk by allowing Senedd Members to do their duties. Diolch yn fawr iawn.
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated: Yn fy nhymor cyntaf fel Aelod o'r Senedd, cefais fy synnu'n fawr fy mod yn gallu mynd i mewn i unrhyw ysgol, unrhyw glwb ieuenctid, unrhyw ddarpariaeth lle roedd plentyn, unigolyn ifanc neu unigolyn agored i niwed yn byw neu'n gweithio heb unrhyw wiriadau, heb unrhyw angen i ddangos unrhyw ddogfennaeth. Ar yr holl ymweliadau hynny, roedd rhywun gyda mi, ond ni fyddai'n cymryd athrylith ac ni fyddai'n cymryd llawer o ddychymyg i rywun eithaf pwerus, sy'n Aelod o'r Senedd, ddweud, 'Hoffwn wneud hyn ar fy mhen fy hun'. Rwy'n credu mai cyfrifoldeb y Senedd yw sicrhau bod Aelodau'r Senedd, sydd â mynediad ac sydd mewn rolau pwerus i ddylanwadu ar bobl eraill—. Dylai ysgwyddo'r cyfrifoldeb. Nid oes unrhyw gyfeiriad at hyn mewn unrhyw ddogfennaeth ddiweddar, ac fe'i codais yn nhymor y Senedd ddiwethaf. Tybed a allai Comisiwn y Senedd fwrw ymlaen â hyn, hyd yn oed ar sail wirfoddol, i edrych ar sut y gallai Aelodau gael gwiriad DBS, nad yw'n rhoi sicrwydd diogelwch llwyr i chi, ond mae'n un ffordd o helpu i sicrhau nad yw'r Senedd hon yn peryglu plant, pobl ifanc a phobl agored i niwed drwy ganiatáu i Aelodau'r Senedd gyflawni eu dyletswyddau. Diolch yn fawr iawn.

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_welsh: 3. Cwestiynau i Gomisiwn y Senedd
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 3. Questions to the Senedd Commission
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim: Thank you. There are a couple of points for consideration here. First of all, the statutory disclosure and barring framework is reserved to UK level, so broadening eligibility for things such as enhanced checks would require action by the UK Government. I'm aware that political parties operate, on a voluntary basis, their own approach to candidates, and it differs from party to party. We watch with interest the different proposals that are emerging currently at a UK level from some individual MPs. Some of them are looking at a statutory basis for changing this, and some at a non-statutory basis. The basic test, as you mentioned, in terms of DBS, as opposed to the enhanced test, has some limitations with it in terms of what it provides. My understanding is that DBS checks are legally designed as a tool for employers or for licensing bodies to assess the suitability of an applicant for a specific workplace role. MSs, of course, not unlike MPs, are not employees, but independent constitutional office holders chosen directly by voters. But it is an interesting area, and we're watching the discussions going on in Westminster at the moment. But the responsibility rests with UK statute.
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated: Diolch. Mae un neu ddau o bwyntiau i'w hystyried yma. Yn gyntaf oll, mae'r fframwaith datgelu a gwahardd statudol yn fater a gedwir yn ôl ar lefel y DU, felly byddai angen camau gweithredu gan Lywodraeth y DU er mwyn ehangu cymhwysedd ar gyfer pethau fel gwiriadau manylach. Rwy'n ymwybodol fod pleidiau gwleidyddol yn gweithredu, ar sail wirfoddol, eu dull eu hunain o ymdrin ag ymgeiswyr, ac mae'n amrywio o blaid i blaid. Rydym yn gwylio gyda diddordeb y gwahanol gynigion sy'n dod i'r amlwg ar hyn o bryd ar lefel y DU gan rai ASau unigol. Mae rhai ohonynt yn edrych ar sail statudol ar gyfer newid hyn, a rhai ar sail anstatudol. Mae gan y prawf sylfaenol, fel y sonioch chi, o ran gwiriadau DBS, yn hytrach na'r prawf manylach, rai cyfyngiadau o ran yr hyn y mae'n ei ddarparu. Fy nealltwriaeth i yw bod gwiriadau DBS wedi'u cynllunio'n gyfreithiol fel dull gweithredu i gyflogwyr neu gyrff trwyddedu i asesu addasrwydd ymgeisydd ar gyfer rôl benodol yn y gweithle. Nid yw Aelodau'r Senedd, wrth gwrs, yn yr un modd ag Aelodau Seneddol y DU, yn weithwyr cyflogedig, ond maent yn ddeiliaid swyddi cyfansoddiadol annibynnol a ddewisir yn uniongyrchol gan bleidleiswyr. Ond mae'n faes diddorol, ac rydym yn gwylio'r trafodaethau sy'n mynd rhagddynt yn San Steffan ar hyn o bryd. Ond statud y DU sydd â'r cyfrifoldeb am hyn.

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim: 9. Pa gamau y mae Comisiwn y Senedd yn eu cymryd i sicrhau bod amrywiaeth o blatfformau cyfryngau newyddion ar gael ar ystad y Senedd? OQ64544
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated: 9. What action is the Senedd Commission taking to ensure a range of news media platforms are available on the Senedd estate? OQ64544

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_welsh: 3. Cwestiynau i Gomisiwn y Senedd
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 3. Questions to the Senedd Commission
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim: Members and staff are able to access all major news outlets using the Senedd IT network on laptops and other Senedd Commission-issued devices. With regard to the internal broadcasting network, this matter is subject to ongoing discussion by Commissioners, and I’m sure Commissioners will gladly report back to their respective groups in due course. All major newspapers are delivered to the Senedd's library and can be accessed by Members and staff.
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated: Mae Aelodau a staff yn gallu cael mynediad at yr holl brif ffynonellau newyddion gan ddefnyddio rhwydwaith TG y Senedd ar liniaduron a dyfeisiau eraill a ddarperir gan Gomisiwn y Senedd. O ran y rhwydwaith darlledu mewnol, mae'r mater yn destun trafodaeth sydd ar y gweill gan y Comisiynwyr, ac rwy'n siŵr y bydd y Comisiynwyr yn fwy na pharod i adrodd yn ôl i'w grwpiau priodol maes o law. Caiff pob prif bapur newydd ei ddanfon i lyfrgell y Senedd a gall Aelodau a staff gael mynediad atynt.

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 3. Questions to the Senedd Commission
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim:
Thank you for that answer. I think we've been here before, haven't we? When the Commission considered this issue in July, it argued that Sky News alone provided proficient plurality on the Senedd's television system. I would respectfully suggest that, in the time since GB News was removed from the Senedd's system, the media landscape has changed. Since the departure of Laurence Fox, GB News has continued to grow its audience and broaden its reach. It now reaches over 1 million viewers per day and, in 2025, overtook Sky News as the UK's largest commercial news channel by average viewing figures.

Whether Members agree with GB News or not is beside the point. It is an Ofcom-regulated broadcaster watched by millions of people across the United Kingdom. I'm sure that everybody on this side of the Chamber is a fan of GB News. Excluding it from the Senedd's internal television system risks creating the impression that some lawful viewpoints are more acceptable than others. In the interests of pluralism, free expression and informed democratic debate, will the Commission now review its policy and reconsider the inclusion of GB News on the Senedd estate? Diolch.
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated:
Diolch am eich ateb. Credaf ein bod wedi bod yma o'r blaen, onid ydym? Pan ystyriodd y Comisiwn y mater ym mis Gorffennaf, dadleuodd mai dim ond Sky News oedd yn darparu plwraliaeth digonol ar system deledu'r Senedd. Buaswn yn awgrymu'n barchus, yn yr amser ers gwahardd GB News oddi ar system y Senedd, fod tirwedd y cyfryngau wedi newid. Ers ymadawiad Laurence Fox, mae cynulleidfa a chyrhaeddiad GB News wedi parhau i dyfu. Mae bellach yn cyrraedd dros 1 filiwn o wylwyr y dydd, ac yn 2025, disodlodd Sky News fel sianel newyddion fasnachol fwyaf y DU yn ôl ffigurau gwylio cyfartalog.

Mae'n amherthnasol a yw'r Aelodau'n cytuno â GB News ai peidio. Mae'n ddarlledwr sy'n cael ei reoleiddio gan Ofcom ac sy'n cael ei wylio gan filiynau o bobl ledled y Deyrnas Unedig. Rwy'n siŵr fod pawb ar yr ochr hon i'r Siambr yn hoff o GB News. Mae perygl y gallai ei wahardd o system deledu fewnol y Senedd greu'r argraff fod rhai safbwyntiau dilys yn fwy derbyniol nag eraill. Yn enw plwraliaeth, rhyddid mynegiant a dadl ddemocrataidd wybodus, a wnaiff y Comisiwn adolygu ei bolisi nawr ac ailystyried caniatáu GB News ar ystad y Senedd? Diolch.

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_welsh: 3. Cwestiynau i Gomisiwn y Senedd
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 3. Questions to the Senedd Commission
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim: Catherine, you are right indeed, we have been here before. At the last Senedd Commission questions, there was quite a lengthy discussion on this. I can't really add much to my opening response. Perhaps it's worth highlighting for the record that press freedom is a principle that we all share. It remains central to the integrity and openness of the democratic institutions here in Wales. This principle, by the way, is reflected, as I mentioned in my opening remarks, in our policy on press passes to the estate as well. It is also reflected in the fact that all the major news outlets can be accessed on the Senedd IT network—on laptops and other Senedd Commission devices—and in the access to all major newspapers in the Senedd library. But as I said earlier, the matter is subject to ongoing discussions by Commissioners, and out of respect to them and those discussions, it's difficult for me to add to my earlier remarks.
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated: Catherine, rydych chi'n llygad eich lle, rydym wedi bod yma o’r blaen. Yn ystod y sesiwn gwestiynau ddiwethaf i Gomisiwn y Senedd, cafwyd trafodaeth eithaf hir ar hyn. Ni allaf ychwanegu llawer at fy ymateb agoriadol mewn gwirionedd. Efallai ei bod yn werth tynnu sylw at y ffaith bod rhyddid y wasg yn egwyddor y mae pob un ohonom yn ei rhannu. Mae’n parhau i fod yn hollbwysig i uniondeb a didwylledd y sefydliadau democrataidd yma yng Nghymru. Mae’r egwyddor hon, gyda llaw, wedi'i hadlewyrchu, fel y soniais yn fy sylwadau agoriadol, yn ein polisi ar basys y wasg i’r ystad hefyd. Fe'i hadlewyrchir hefyd yn y ffaith y gellir cael mynediad at yr holl brif ffynonellau newyddion ar rwydwaith TG y Senedd—ar liniaduron a dyfeisiau eraill Comisiwn y Senedd—ac yn y mynediad at yr holl brif bapurau newydd yn llyfrgell y Senedd. Ond fel y dywedais yn gynharach, mae’r mater yn destun trafodaeth barhaus gan y Comisiynwyr, ac er parch iddynt hwy a’r trafodaethau hynny, mae’n anodd imi ychwanegu at fy sylwadau cynharach.

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated: Routes Linking Tŷ Hywel and the Siambr

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_welsh: 3. Cwestiynau i Gomisiwn y Senedd
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 3. Questions to the Senedd Commission
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim: 10. A wnaiff y Comisiwn ystyried llwybrau amgen sy'n cysylltu Tŷ Hywel â'r Siambr i helpu i leihau tagfeydd yn ystod y Cyfarfod Llawn? OQ64548
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated: 10. Will the Commission consider alternative routes linking Tŷ Hywel to the Siambr to help alleviate bottlenecks during Plenary? OQ64548

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_welsh: 3. Cwestiynau i Gomisiwn y Senedd
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 3. Questions to the Senedd Commission
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim: Diolch, Gwyn. Ease of access to the existing routes from Tŷ Hywel to the Senedd building, and significant improvements to how the buildings connect for Members and other users, is actively being looked at in detail as part of the Bay 32 project. The Commission is not, however, currently considering any further alternative physical bridges, for example, to the Senedd building from Tŷ Hywel. There are two link bridges that provide access from Tŷ Hywel to the Senedd building—one via the first floor staff restaurant and one on the second floor. Access from the first floor link bridge is via lifts only. The second floor link bridge directly joins the Senedd building, with no lift required. Direct access is also available at ground floor level via the Senedd building courtyards.
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated: Diolch, Gwyn. Mae rhwyddineb mynediad i'r llwybrau presennol o Dŷ Hywel i adeilad y Senedd, a gwelliannau sylweddol i'r ffordd y mae'r adeiladau'n cysylltu â'i gilydd ar gyfer Aelodau a defnyddwyr eraill, yn cael eu hystyried yn fanwl fel rhan o brosiect Bae 32. Fodd bynnag, nid yw'r Comisiwn yn ystyried unrhyw bontydd ffisegol eraill ar hyn o bryd, er enghraifft i adeilad y Senedd o Dŷ Hywel. Mae dwy bont gyswllt yn darparu mynediad o Dŷ Hywel i adeilad y Senedd—un drwy fwyty'r staff ar y llawr cyntaf ac un ar yr ail lawr. Dim ond drwy lifftiau y ceir mynediad o bont gyswllt y llawr cyntaf. Mae pont gyswllt yr ail lawr yn cysylltu'n uniongyrchol ag adeilad y Senedd, heb fod angen lifft. Mae mynediad uniongyrchol ar gael hefyd ar lefel y llawr gwaelod drwy gowtydd adeilad y Senedd.

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_welsh: 3. Cwestiynau i Gomisiwn y Senedd
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 3. Questions to the Senedd Commission
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim: Diolch yn fawr. I would humbly suggest, as a new Member, as many of the people here are—. The level of the canteen, which is marked M, and the first floor and the stairwell on the other side, as you said in your answer, can only be connected via a lift. It does seem to be, at busy periods, a bottleneck of people. I have lost count of the number of long-serving staff, including a very nice lady called Sam, who works in the tea room here—. She has said that she has lost count of the number of times that she has suggested a flight of steps connecting that level with the stairwell on the other side. And there is some space to the side. So, would the Commission agree that this is a bottleneck and that a simple addition of a flight of steps would ease congestion? Would you look into it further so that I can report back to Sam in the tea room?
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated: Diolch yn fawr. Carwn awgrymu'n garedig, fel Aelod newydd, gan fod llawer o'r bobl yma—. Fel y dywedoch chi yn eich ateb, dim ond drwy lifft y gellir cysylltu lefel y ffreutur, sydd wedi'i nodi fel lefel M, â'r llawr cyntaf a'r grisiau ar yr ochr arall. Ar adegau prysur, mae'n ymddangos bod hyn yn creu tagfa. Rwyf wedi colli cyfrif ar nifer y staff sydd wedi bod yma ers amser maith, yn cynnwys menyw ddymunol iawn o'r enw Sam, sy'n gweithio yn yr ystafell de yma—. Mae hi wedi dweud ei bod wedi colli cyfrif ar nifer y troeon y mae wedi awgrymu grisiau i gysylltu'r lefel honno â'r grisiau ar yr ochr arall. Ac mae rhywfaint o le ar yr ochr. Felly, a fyddai'r Comisiwn yn cytuno bod tagfa yma ac y byddai ychwanegu rhes o risiau yn lleihau tagfeydd? A wnewch chi ymchwilio i hyn ymhellach er mwyn i mi adrodd yn ôl i Sam yn yr ystafell de?

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_welsh: 3. Cwestiynau i Gomisiwn y Senedd
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 3. Questions to the Senedd Commission
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim: Now we're put right on the spot, because if Sam is keeping an eye on this, my goodness. As I mentioned, the proposals we're looking at for developing and enhancing the facilities here include those routes from one part of the building to the other—from Tŷ Hywel to the Senedd. So, it's under consideration by the Commissioners in the plans going forward. It won't be immediate—I can't promise that. Meanwhile, we're all going to have to work hard to avoid that last-minute bottleneck where we're all jammed in with Sam, with very important services and goods being taken across at the same time that we're rushing down for the bell. Diolch.
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated: Rydym o dan y chwyddwydr nawr, oherwydd os yw Sam yn cadw llygad ar hyn, mam bach. Fel y soniais, mae'r cynigion rydym yn edrych arnynt ar gyfer datblygu a gwella'r cyfleusterau yma yn cynnwys y llwybrau o un rhan o'r adeilad i'r llall—o Dŷ Hywel i'r Senedd. Felly, bydd hyn yn cael ei ystyried gan y Comisiynwyr yn y cynlluniau wrth symud ymlaen. Ni fydd yn digwydd ar unwaith—ni allaf addo hynny. Yn y cyfamser, bydd yn rhaid i bob un ohonom weithio'n galed i osgoi'r dagfa funud olaf honno lle mae pob un ohonom yn cael ein gwasgu i mewn gyda Sam, gyda gwasanaethau a nwyddau pwysig iawn yn cael eu cludo ar yr un pryd ag y byddwn yn rhuthro i lawr ar gyfer y gloch. Diolch.

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_welsh: 5. Datganiadau 90 eiliad
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 5. 90-second Statements
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim:
Diolch. This week is Adult Learners' Week, and I'd like to pay tribute to all the adult learners across Wales. It's sometimes difficult to step back into education, so it's so important that there's support there for them. The impact of adult learning is life-changing, and extends far beyond education. It improves health and well-being, and is fundamental to Wales's economic growth. It enables adults to access upskilling and reskilling and enhance their lives in ways that we will never understand. 

The adult community learning programme in particular offers people an important route into education, supporting people to access learning in a setting and at a pace that is right for them. Tonight, the Inspire! adult learning awards are going to take place, and I'd like to congratulate Hannah from my constituency in Caerdydd Penarth who will be receiving the new Welsh speaker award. 

Hannah will be recognised alongside 10 other award winners who are all being celebrated for their commitment, dedication and achievements—learners who have changed their lives through adult education. I hope these stories, and thousands like them across Wales, can encourage more people to embrace the message of Adult Learners' Week—to never stop learning. Diolch.
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated:
Diolch. Mae'n Wythnos Addysg Oedolion yr wythnos hon, a hoffwn dalu teyrnged i'r holl oedolion sy'n ddysgwyr ledled Cymru. Weithiau, mae'n anodd camu'n ôl i addysg, felly mae mor bwysig fod y gefnogaeth yno iddynt. Mae effaith addysg oedolion yn newid bywydau, ac yn ymestyn ymhell y tu hwnt i addysg. Mae'n gwella iechyd a lles, ac mae'n hanfodol i dwf economaidd Cymru. Mae'n galluogi oedolion i uwchsgilio ac ailsgilio a gwella eu bywydau mewn ffyrdd na fyddwn byth yn eu deall.

Mae'r rhaglen dysgu oedolion yn y gymuned yn enwedig yn cynnig llwybr pwysig i bobl i mewn i addysg, gan gefnogi pobl i gael mynediad at addysg mewn lleoliad ac ar gyflymder sy'n addas iddynt hwy. Heno, cynhelir gwobrau addysg oedolion Ysbrydoli!, a hoffwn longyfarch Hannah o fy etholaeth yng Nghaerdydd Penarth a fydd yn derbyn y wobr ar gyfer siaradwyr Cymraeg newydd.

Bydd Hannah yn cael ei chydnabod ochr yn ochr â 10 enillydd arall sydd oll yn cael eu dathlu am eu hymrwymiad, eu hymroddiad a'u cyflawniadau—dysgwyr sydd wedi newid eu bywydau drwy addysg oedolion. Rwy'n gobeithio y gall y straeon hyn, a miloedd o rai tebyg ledled Cymru, annog mwy o bobl i gofleidio neges Wythnos Addysg Oedolion—i beidio byth â rhoi'r gorau i ddysgu. Diolch.

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_welsh: 5. Datganiadau 90 eiliad
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 5. 90-second Statements
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim:
Last Friday marked International Equal Pay Day, a UN awareness day of gender inequality and the gender pay gap between men and women. Sadly, this is a pressing issue for Wales. The latest state of the nation report on gender equality by the Women's Equality Network Wales exposed that the gender pay gap in Wales has widened to 9.7 per cent. On average, female employees earn £15.78 per hour, whilst male employees earn £17.48. Compared to men, women are over three times more likely to be out of the job market due to caring responsibilities. Women are also three times more likely to work part-time, which is limiting to earnings and progression. And women are more likely to work in sectors and roles that are lower paid, such as health and social care. We need change. 

Barriers to economic equality, like unequal caring responsibilities and gender stereotypes, must be challenged. Women must be supported to access better paid jobs, skills and training programmes throughout their careers, and we must have robust and inclusive policies on flexible working, harassment, menopause and parental leave. This International Equal Pay Day, I urge all colleagues across the Senedd to champion gender equality and help create a Wales free from gender discrimination. Diolch yn fawr.
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated:
Ddydd Gwener diwethaf, roedd hi'n Ddiwrnod Cyflog Cyfartal Rhyngwladol, diwrnod ymwybyddiaeth y Cenhedloedd Unedig o anghydraddoldeb rhywedd a'r bwlch cyflog rhwng dynion a menywod. Yn anffodus, mae hwn yn fater brys i Gymru. Datgelodd yr adroddiad diweddaraf ar gyflwr y genedl o ran cydraddoldeb rhywedd gan Rwydwaith Cydraddoldeb Menywod Cymru fod y bwlch cyflog rhywedd yng Nghymru wedi ehangu i 9.7 y cant. Ar gyfartaledd, mae gweithwyr benywaidd yn ennill £15.78 yr awr, tra bo gweithwyr gwrywaidd yn ennill £17.48. O gymharu â dynion, mae menywod dros deirgwaith yn fwy tebygol o fod allan o'r farchnad swyddi oherwydd cyfrifoldebau gofalu. Mae menywod deirgwaith yn fwy tebygol hefyd o fod yn gweithio'n rhan-amser, sy'n cyfyngu ar enillion a chynnydd. Ac mae menywod yn fwy tebygol o fod yn gweithio mewn sectorau a rolau sydd â chyflogau is, fel iechyd a gofal cymdeithasol. Mae angen newid arnom.

Rhaid herio rhwystrau i gydraddoldeb economaidd, fel cyfrifoldebau gofalu anghyfartal a stereoteipiau rhywedd. Rhaid cefnogi menywod i gael mynediad at swyddi ar gyflogau gwell, sgiliau a rhaglenni hyfforddi drwy gydol eu gyrfaoedd, a rhaid inni gael polisïau cadarn a chynhwysol ar waith ar weithio hyblyg, aflonyddu, menopos ac absenoldeb rhiant. I nodi'r Diwrnod Cyflog Cyfartal Rhyngwladol, rwy'n annog pob un o fy nghyd-Aelodau ar draws y Senedd i hyrwyddo cydraddoldeb rhywedd a helpu i greu Cymru sy'n rhydd rhag gwahaniaethu ar sail rhywedd. Diolch yn fawr.

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_welsh: 5. Datganiadau 90 eiliad
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 5. 90-second Statements
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim:
Next month, Wyeside Arts Centre in Builth Wells celebrates an incredible milestone—50 years of bringing arts and culture to the heart of rural mid Wales. The fiftieth birthday weekend brings that history to life, with Welsh music, poetry, art and community participation. At its centre is Cymuned Gwy, a new bilingual work commissioned for the anniversary, inspired by the River Wye and the people who live alongside it. Wyeside is a small, independent charity, but its contribution is anything but small. Open six days a week, it provides cinema, live performance, music, exhibitions and opportunities for people to come together across a large rural area. 

Places like Wyeside offer far more than entertainment. They are places where people meet, participate and belong. The anniversary, as well as looking forward and back, has amazing plans to introduce to people as well, which will improve accessibility, and new facilities that will serve mid Wales for decades to come. Alongside this celebration, we know there is a serious challenge. Despite operating all year round, generating much of its income, and being supported by a small team of volunteers, Wyeside continues to face a significant revenue shortfall. I congratulate everyone who has sustained Wyeside over 50 years, and encourage colleagues to join the celebrations from 9 to 11 October, to see its plans for the future, and help ensure it remains at the heart of mid Wales. Diolch yn fawr iawn.
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated:
Y mis nesaf, bydd Canolfan Gelfyddydau Glannau Gwy yn Llanfair-ym-Muallt yn dathlu carreg filltir anhygoel—50 mlynedd o ddod â chelfyddydau a diwylliant i galon cefn gwlad canolbarth Cymru. Mae penwythnos yr hanner canfed pen-blwydd yn dod â’r hanes hwnnw’n fyw, gyda chyfranogiad cymunedol, cerddoriaeth, barddoniaeth a chelfyddyd Gymreig. Wrth wraidd hyn oll mae Cymuned Gwy, gwaith dwyieithog newydd a gomisiynwyd ar gyfer y pen-blwydd, wedi’i ysbrydoli gan afon Gwy a’r bobl sy’n byw ar hyd-ddi. Elusen fach, annibynnol yw'r ganolfan, ond mae ei chyfraniad ymhell o fod yn fach. Mae ar agor chwe diwrnod yr wythnos ac yn darparu sinema, perfformiadau byw, cerddoriaeth, arddangosfeydd a chyfleoedd i bobl ddod at ei gilydd ar draws ardal wledig fawr.

Mae lleoedd fel Canolfan Gelfyddydau Glannau Gwy yn cynnig llawer mwy nag adloniant yn unig. Maent yn lleoedd lle mae pobl yn cyfarfod, yn cymryd rhan ac yn perthyn. Yn ogystal ag edrych ymlaen ac yn ôl, mae gan y dathliad gynlluniau anhygoel i'w cyflwyno i bobl hefyd, a fydd yn gwella hygyrchedd, a chyfleusterau newydd a fydd yn gwasanaethu canolbarth Cymru am ddegawdau i ddod. Ochr yn ochr â'r dathliad hwn, gwyddom fod yna her ddifrifol. Er ei bod yn gweithredu drwy gydol y flwyddyn, yn cynhyrchu llawer o'i hincwm, ac yn cael ei chefnogi gan dîm bach o wirfoddolwyr, mae canolfan Glannau Gwy yn parhau i wynebu diffyg refeniw sylweddol. Rwy'n llongyfarch pawb sydd wedi cynnal y ganolfan ers dros 50 mlynedd, ac yn annog fy nghyd-Aelodau i ymuno â'r dathliadau rhwng 9 a 11 Hydref, i weld ei chynlluniau ar gyfer y dyfodol, a helpu i sicrhau ei bod yn parhau i fod yn hollbwysig i ganolbarth Cymru. Diolch yn fawr iawn.

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_welsh: 5. Datganiadau 90 eiliad
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 5. 90-second Statements
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim:
It's Migraine Awareness Week, and I want to recognise people across Wales living with a condition that is too often dismissed. Migraines affect one in seven people in the UK. It's a neurological condition that can cause severe pain, sickness and sensitivity to light and sound. Its impact reaches far beyond an attack. It affects work, family life and mental well-being. 

The Migraine Trust's latest survey found that nine in 10 respondents had felt disbelief about the severity or the impact of their migraine. Nearly a third had experienced this from their colleagues or their managers. More than three quarters say that the disbelief has damaged their mental health. Nobody should have to fight to be believed while already struggling with pain. The trust's 'Believe me' campaign carries a simple message to us all: listen, take migraine seriously and offer practical support. To people living with migraine in Gŵyr Abertawe, and across Wales: your experience matters. Pain does not have to be visible to deserve understanding, and a little patience and compassion can make a difference. Diolch.

Mae'n gyflwr niwrolegol a all achosi poen difrifol, salwch a sensitifrwydd i olau a sain. Mae ei effaith yn ymestyn ymhell y tu hwnt i'r pwl ei hun.
